title.en: Excavation work on Trump’s towering, gilded arch to begin over next two weeks
title.zh: 特朗普的宏伟镀金拱门工程将在两周内开始

summary.en: Excavation work is set to begin within two weeks on a towering, gilded arch proposed by the Trump administration in Washington D.C. The project faces a lawsuit and criticism from those who believe it will disrupt historic sightlines. This arch is one of several initiatives by the former president aimed at leaving a...
summary.zh: 特朗普政府提出的一个宏伟的镀金拱门项目，其挖掘工作将在两周内开始。该项目面临诉讼，并遭到批评者反对，他们认为该项目将破坏历史性的景观视线。这座拱门是这位前总统旨在给首都留下深刻印记的几项举措之一。

body.en: Project that critics say will disrupt historic sightlines in Washington DC is facing a lawsuit The Trump administration said on Thursday that excavation work will start over the next two weeks on the site where it plans to build a towering, gilded arch, a project that is facing a lawsuit and that critics say will disrupt historic sightlines in Washington DC. The proposed arch is one of several projects the Republican president is pursuing to leave his lasting imprint on Washington, including renaming and renovating the Kennedy Center, building a huge new White House ballroom, refurbishing the Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool and rebuilding a golf course in East Potomac Park that could significantly reduce the public’s access to running and biking paths. Continue reading...
body.zh: 批评者称将破坏华盛顿特区历史景观的项目面临诉讼特朗普政府周四表示，挖掘工作将在未来两周内开始，计划在该地点建造一座高耸的镀金拱门，该项目正面临诉讼，批评者称该项目将破坏华盛顿特区的历史景观。拟议的拱门是共和党总统正在寻求在华盛顿留下永久印记的几个项目之一，包括重命名和翻新肯尼迪中心、建造一个巨大的新白宫宴会厅、翻新林肯纪念堂倒影池以及重建东波托马克公园的高尔夫球场，这可能会大大减少公众使用跑步和自行车道的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The construction of a prominent arch in Washington D.C. raises questions about how public spaces are shaped and whose vision prevails. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." While not a direct case of oppression, the principle of responsible stewardship of...
reflection.zh: 在华盛顿特区建造一座显眼的拱门，引发了关于公共空间如何塑造以及谁的愿景占主导地位的问题。《耶利米书》22:3 呼吁领导者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。虽然这不是直接的压迫案例，但负责任地管理公共遗产以及对社区共享景观的影响，是掌权者需要考虑的相关原则。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live. Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Huge relief’ after two more Australians located, but still ‘serious concerns’, Chalmers says The Albanese government still has “serious concerns” for the Australians missing in the Nepal-Tibet floods, Jim Chalmers says. Speaking to ABC’s News Breakfast, the treasurer said it was “good news that two Australians have been located overnight [but] we are concerned for the 36 who are still unaccounted for”. That would be a huge relief to the loved ones of these two Australians who’ve been located, but we still have very serious concerns for the 36 Australians that we haven’t been able to be located yet. This is very much designed to try and get the government back in control of the nicotine market, not organised crime gangs. We are hoping that the combined package of what we’re proposing here, not just the dropping of the excise, but the regulation of the market and making it certainly more difficult for children to access these products. In the enforcement surge and the anti-smoking and anti-vaping campaigns, we are hoping to put downward pressure on smoking rates. Continue reading...

reflection.en: In the midst of the Nepal-Tibet floods, the news that two more Australians have been located brings immense relief to their families. While concerns remain for those still missing, this specific instance of finding loved ones offers a moment of profound gratitude and joy after a period of intense anxiety. It reminds us that even in widespread crisis,...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾难中，又有两名澳大利亚人被找到的消息给他们的家人带来了巨大的宽慰。尽管仍有人失踪，但找到亲人的这一具体事例，在经历了强烈的焦虑之后，带来了深刻的感恩和喜悦。这提醒我们，即使在普遍的危机中，个别时刻的希望和重逢也能穿透黑暗。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

This situation raises questions about accountability and transparency, especially when the investigation concerns the welfare of survivors. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves not...
reflection.zh: 面对严重的指控和政府的调查，金融家莱昂·布莱克选择通过法律挑战来规避，而不是提供答案。这种情况引发了关于问责制和透明度的问题，尤其当调查涉及幸存者的福祉时。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于不行恶，更在于积极追求公义和显出怜悯。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Two more Australians found safe after deadly Nepal floods but dozens still missing
title.zh: 尼泊尔致命洪水后又两名澳大利亚人获救，但仍有数十人失踪

summary.en: Two more Australians who were unaccounted for in the Nepal-Tibet flash floods have been confirmed safe, bringing relief to their families. However, concerns remain for 36 other Australians still missing following the disaster.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏的特大洪水灾害中失联的两名澳大利亚公民已被确认安全，这给他们的家人带来了巨大的宽慰。然而，在这次灾难之后，仍有36名澳大利亚人下落不明，令人担忧。

body.en:
Two more Australians who were unaccounted for in the Nepal-Tibet flash floods have been confirmed safe.

SBS News understands the two citizens were uncontactable but have since been confirmed safe and do not require consular assistance.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers said the news would be a "huge relief" for their loved ones, but the government held serious concerns for those who remain unaccounted for.

"Good news that two Australians have been located overnight. We are concerned for the 36 who are still unaccounted for," he told ABC News Breakfast.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Chalmers said Australia was "sending some of its best people" to assist with search-and-rescue efforts.

Australia has deployed 19 officials and disaster response specialists to Nepal, with a further 23 to be deployed in the coming days.

A 15-person Australian Disaster Assistance Response Team (DART) is expected to arrive in Kathmandu on Friday, while Australian Federal Police (AFP) disaster victim identification specialists are expected to touch down over the weekend.

The AFP has allocated a family investigative liaison officer to provide support, information and guidance to families of the Australians who remain unaccounted for.

That includes assisting families with identification requirements, such as collecting DNA from family members.

The Australian government has committed $11 million to support disaster response and recovery efforts.

As of Thursday, the Nepali government reported 1,259 confirmed deaths and 5,083 people missing, including 583 foreign nationals.

The scale of the destruction is also becoming clearer, with authorities estimating around 20,000 homes will need to be rebuilt in safer locations, according to Reuters.

Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of Nepal's disaster response authority, told Reuters preliminary estimates showed 7,500 houses had been completely destroyed, either washed away or buried under debris and mud.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏山洪爆发中失踪的另外两名澳大利亚人已被确认安全。 SBS 新闻了解到，目前无法联系到这两名公民，但已确认他们安全，不需要领事协助。 财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯表示，这一消息对他们的亲人来说将是“巨大的安慰”，但政府对那些下落不明的人表示严重关切。 他告诉美国广播公司早餐新闻：“好消息是，连夜找到了两名澳大利亚人。我们对仍然下落不明的 36 人感到担忧。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 查尔默斯表示，澳大利亚正在“派遣一些最优秀的人员”协助搜救工作。 澳大利亚已向尼泊尔派遣了 19 名官员和救灾专家，未来几天还将再派遣 23 名官员和救灾专家。 一支由 15 人组成的澳大利亚灾难援助响应小组 (DART) 预计将于周五抵达加德满都，而澳大利亚联邦警察 (AFP) 的灾难受害者识别专家预计将在周末抵达。 法新社已指派一名家庭调查联络官，为下落不明的澳大利亚人的家人提供支持、信息和指导。 这包括协助家庭满足身份识别要求，例如收集家庭成员的 DNA。 澳大利亚政府已承诺投入 1100 万美元支持救灾和恢复工作。 截至周四，尼泊尔政府报告确认死亡人数为 1,259 人，失踪人数为 5,083 人，其中包括 583 名外国人。 据路透社报道，破坏的规模也越来越明显，当局估计大约 20,000 所房屋需要在更安全的地方重建。 尼泊尔救灾机构负责人达玛·拉杰·乌普雷蒂 (Dharma Raj Upreti) 告诉路透社，初步估计显示，7,500 所房屋已被完全摧毁，要么被冲走，要么被埋在废墟和泥土中。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news from Nepal brings a mix of relief and lingering anxiety. While it is a comfort that two more Australians are safe, the ongoing uncertainty for the 36 still missing underscores the precariousness of life. In times of such crisis, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔传来的消息夹杂着宽慰与挥之不去的焦虑。虽然又有两名澳大利亚人安然无恙令人欣慰，但仍有36人下落不明，这凸显了生命的脆弱。在这样的危机时刻，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，上帝是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: JD Vance reacts to airstrike that killed four at Iran wedding: ‘Things happen’
title.zh: JD Vance就伊朗婚礼空袭致四人死亡事件作出回应：“事情会发生”

summary.en: US Vice President JD Vance expressed skepticism about Iranian reports regarding an airstrike that killed four people, including a child, at a wedding in southern Iran. The strike occurred in Kuhestak, Sirik county. The casualty figures were reported by the Iranian Red Crescent, an organization generally considered...
summary.zh: 美国副总统JD Vance对伊朗方面关于空袭造成包括一名儿童在内的四人死亡的报道表示怀疑，此次空袭发生在伊朗南部的一场婚礼上。袭击发生在锡里克县的库赫斯塔克镇。伤亡数字由伊朗红新月会报告，该组织通常被国际监测机构视为可信来源。

body.en: US vice-president says he’s ‘extremely skeptical’ of Iran reports when asked whether US was responsible for deaths The US vice-president, JD Vance, said “sometimes things happen” when asked on Thursday whether an American strike was responsible for killing four people, including a child, at a wedding celebration in southern Iran this week. The strike hit Kuhestak, a town in Sirik county on the strait of Hormuz. The toll was reported not by the Iranian government but by the Iranian Red Crescent, a member of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement that operates independently of Tehran and is generally treated by international monitors as a credible source on casualty figures. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当被问及美国是否应对死亡事件负责时，美国副总统表示，他对伊朗的报道“极度怀疑”。周四，当被问及本周在伊朗南部举行的一场婚礼上，当被问及美国的一次袭击是否导致包括一名儿童在内的四人死亡时，美国副总统万斯表示，“有时会发生一些事情”。袭击袭击了霍尔木兹海峡西里县的库赫斯塔克镇。报告死亡人数的不是伊朗政府，而是伊朗红新月会。伊朗红新月会是国际红十字与红新月运动的成员，独立于德黑兰运作，通常被国际监测人员视为伤亡数字的可靠来源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news reports a US vice-president’s dismissive comment, “sometimes things happen,” in response to the deaths of civilians, including a child, at a wedding. This casual dismissal of loss, especially when reports suggest potential responsibility, echoes the dangerous cycle of violence and indifference that Scripture calls us to overcome. We are urged not...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了一位美国副总统在被问及伊朗南部一场婚礼上包括一名儿童在内的平民死亡事件时，轻描淡写地表示“事情会发生”。这种对生命损失的随意态度，尤其是在有报道暗示可能存在责任的情况下，呼应了圣经所告诫我们要去克服的暴力和冷漠的危险循环。我们被敦促不要以恶报恶，而是要积极行善，即使面对悲剧和潜在的报复。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Reform officials ‘plotted to break law on foreign donations’ in undercover film
title.zh: 改革官员被指在卧底影片中密谋违反外国捐款法

summary.en: An investigation broadcast by Channel 4 News shows an undercover journalist posing as an 'impermissible donor' paying for polling that benefited Reform UK. This has led to fresh criticism of Nigel Farage's team on the eve of the party conference, as they were filmed appearing to plot ways to circumvent electoral laws...
summary.zh: 英国第四频道新闻台播出的调查显示，一名卧底记者假扮“禁止的捐助者”，支付了有助于改革党（Reform UK）的民意调查费用。在改革党大会前夕，该党一些成员被拍到似乎在密谋规避有关外国捐款的选举法，这引发了对该党领导人奈杰尔·法拉奇团队的新一轮批评。

body.en: Investigation broadcast by Channel 4 News shows man posing as ‘impermissible donor’ paying for polling that helped Reform Nigel Farage is facing fresh criticism on the eve of the Reform UK party conference after some of his team were filmed appearing to plot to avoid electoral laws on foreign donations in an undercover investigation broadcast by Channel 4 News. A group of investigative journalists called Verbatim, founded by the Centre for Climate Reporting , posed as a potential Reform supporter and his wealthy American father, an impermissible donor, who paid for £30,000 of polling commissioned by Reform and which benefited the party. Continue reading...
body.zh: 第四频道新闻播出的调查显示，在英国改革党会议前夕，冒充“非法捐助者”为民意调查付费帮助改革的男子奈杰尔·法拉奇面临着新的批评，此前他的一些团队在第四频道新闻播出的一项卧底调查中被拍到似乎密谋规避有关外国捐款的选举法。由气候报告中心成立的一群名为 Verbatim 的调查记者冒充潜在的改革派支持者和他富有的美国父亲，一位不允许的捐赠者，他为改革派委托的民意调查支付了 3 万英镑，这使该党受益。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news report alleges a plot to circumvent electoral laws regarding foreign donations. This raises questions about integrity and accountability in political dealings. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God,' a principle that should guide all public service.
reflection.zh: 该新闻报道指控有人密谋规避有关外国捐款的选举法。这引发了关于政治交易中诚信和问责制的问题。《弥迦书》6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行”，这一原则应指导所有公共服务。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ICE agent charged with lying about shooting Venezuelan man during crackdown
title.zh: ICE探员被控在镇压期间向委内瑞拉男子开枪时撒谎

summary.en: An ICE officer faces federal charges related to a shooting incident in Minnesota in January.
summary.zh: 一名ICE官员因涉及一月份在明尼苏达州发生的枪击事件而面临联邦指控。

body.en:
A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent has been charged with lying about the non-fatal shooting of a Venezuelan migrant in the state of Minnesota.

Christian Castro, who is not yet in custody, faces a six-count federal indictment relating to shooting on 14 January, according to the BBC's US media partner CBS.

The Department of Homeland Security initially said he fired in self-defence after being attacked by three Venezuelan illegal migrants with a shovel and broom handle. Minnesota investigators allege Castro fired through a closed door, shooting the man in the leg.

It is rare for the current justice department to accuse a federal agent of breaking the law on the job.

In Minnesota, Castro faces separate charges of assault and false reporting of a crime related to the shooting.

Castro was one of thousands of federal immigration officers deployed to the Midwestern state during Operation Metro Surge, which sparked fierce protests and resulted in the deaths of two US citizens at the hands of agents during confrontations.

Alfredo Alejandro Aljorna and Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis, who was shot in the leg and survived, were originally charged with forcibly assaulting, resisting or impeding federal officers.

After surveillance video raised questions about the agents' version of events, federal prosecutors investigated them.

In February, ICE said two immigration agents might have made "untruthful statements" about the shooting. They were placed on administrative leave.

The charges against the migrants were dismissed, with prosecutors citing "newly discovered evidence", CBS reported.

Minnesota's top prosecutor asked for him to be extradited to stand trial, but Texas Governor Greg Abbott said he did not approve the request because he had "serious doubts" that Castro qualified as a fugitive.

Minnesota officials have said the agent discharged his weapon through the front door of a home "knowing there were people who had just run inside".

The bullet went through the door and struck one person in the leg, making its final impact in the wall of a child's room, they said.
body.zh: 一名美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）特工被指控对明尼苏达州一名委内瑞拉移民被枪杀的事件撒谎。 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 报道，尚未被拘留的克里斯蒂安·卡斯特罗 (Christian Castro) 面临与 1 月 14 日枪击案有关的六项联邦起诉。 美国国土安全部最初表示，他在遭到三名委内瑞拉非法移民用铲子和扫帚柄袭击后出于自卫而开枪。明尼苏达州调查人员称，卡斯特罗通过一扇紧闭的门开枪，射中了该男子的腿部。 现任司法部很少指控联邦特工在工作中违法。 在明尼苏达州，卡斯特罗面临袭击和虚假报道与枪击事件相关的犯罪指控。 卡斯特罗是在“地铁激增”行动期间部署到中西部州的数千名联邦移民官员之一，该行动引发了激烈的抗议，并导致两名美国公民在对抗中死于特工之手。 腿部中弹幸存的阿尔弗雷多·亚历杭德罗·阿尔约纳和胡里奥·塞萨尔·索萨-塞利斯最初被指控强行攻击、抵抗或阻碍联邦官员。 在监控录像对特工对事件的描述提出质疑后，联邦检察官对他们进行了调查。 二月份，ICE 表示两名移民官员可能对枪击事件做出了“不实陈述”。他们被安排行政休假。 据哥伦比亚广播公司报道，检察官援引“新发现的证据”，驳回了对移民的指控。 明尼苏达州最高检察官要求引渡卡斯特罗接受审判，但得克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特表示，他没有批准这一请求，因为他“严重怀疑”卡斯特罗是否符合逃亡资格。 明尼苏达州官员表示，这名特工从一户人家的前门开枪，“知道有人刚刚跑进去”。 他们说，子弹穿过门，击中一人的腿部，最后击中儿童房间的墙壁。

reflection.en: This story highlights a serious accusation against a federal agent for allegedly lying about a shooting incident. The charges bring into focus the critical biblical call to seek justice and to act with compassion. When authority figures are accused of misconduct, the community's trust is tested, underscoring the need for accountability and truth.
reflection.zh: 这个故事揭露了一名联邦探员被控在枪击事件中撒谎的严重指控。这些指控凸显了圣经中对寻求公义和怀有怜悯之心的重要呼召。当掌权者被指控不当行为时，社区的信任受到考验，这更加强调了对问责制和真相的需要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" regarding China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which flew over several members without adequate notice. The communique called for transparency and advance notification of at least 24 hours, with Nauru...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了多个成员国领土。公报呼吁提高透明度并提前至少24小时通知，18个成员国中仅瑙鲁表示反对。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have navigated a delicate diplomatic situation, expressing concern over a missile test while refraining from outright condemnation. This reflects a commitment to maintaining regional stability and pursuing peace, even amidst geopolitical tensions. The call for transparency and advance notice highlights a desire for...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人处理了一个微妙的外交局面，他们对一次导弹试验表示关切，但避免了直接谴责。这反映了在紧张的地缘政治局势下，维护地区稳定和追求和平的承诺。呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，凸显了对可预测互动以维护国际准则的渴望。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Nepal tunnel rescuers hunt for survivors with rafts and drone
title.zh: 尼泊尔隧道救援人员用筏子和无人机搜寻幸存者

summary.en: Eight days after deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, rescuers continue to search for survivors believed to be trapped in tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River. The floods, caused by a glacial collapse in the Himalayas, have killed at least 1,200 people and left thousands missing, devastating roads and...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命的洪水灾难八天后，救援人员仍在搜寻据信被困在尼泊尔特里苏里河沿岸隧道中的幸存者。这场由喜马拉雅山脉冰川崩塌引发的洪水已造成至少1200人死亡，数千人失踪，摧毁了道路和村庄。

body.en:
Eight days on from the deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, rescuers were still looking for survivors who are thought to be trapped inside tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River.

At least 1,200 people have died and thousands more are missing after a "glacial collapse" high in the Himalayas, led to floodwater and debris sweeping through roads and villages. B

BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri travelled to one of the sites of one of the tunnels.
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境发生致命的山洪爆发八天后，救援人员仍在寻找据信被困在尼泊尔特里舒利河沿岸隧道内的幸存者。 喜马拉雅山高处发生“冰川崩塌”，导致洪水和废墟席卷道路和村庄，造成至少 1,200 人死亡，数千人失踪。乙 BBC 南亚记者阿扎德·莫希里 (Azadeh Moshiri) 前往其中一处隧道遗址之一。

reflection.en: Even days after the devastating floods, hope persists as rescuers brave dangerous tunnels in Nepal. This tenacious search for life mirrors the biblical call to practical compassion, to "share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter." In the face of such widespread loss, these efforts embody a profound commitment to human...
reflection.zh: 即使在毁灭性的洪水发生多天后，随着救援人员冒着危险在尼泊尔的隧道中搜寻，希望依然存在。这种顽强搜寻生命的努力，呼应了圣经中实践怜悯的呼召——“要将你的食物分给饥饿的，并将流亡的穷人接到你家中”。面对如此广泛的损失，这些行动体现了对人类尊严和每个生命价值的深刻承诺。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Will Australia's $600 million deal make a dent in the Pacific's Cocaine highway?
title.zh: 澳大利亚6亿澳元交易能否撼动太平洋的可卡因高速公路？

summary.en: The expansion of Australian motorcycle gangs into Pacific nations has spurred on the region's drug trade. Australia has announced a $600 million program to strengthen aerial and maritime surveillance across the Pacific, targeting drug smuggling routes. Pacific island nations are difficult to police and have...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚摩托车帮派向太平洋国家扩张，刺激了该地区毒品贸易。澳大利亚宣布了一项耗资6亿澳元的计划，以加强太平洋地区的空中和海上侦察，打击毒品走私路线。太平洋岛国难以监管，执法人员不足，使其成为贩毒者的天堂。

body.en:
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced a $600 million program to strengthen aerial and maritime surveillance across the Pacific, targeting the narco-submarines and small vessels used to move drugs through the region.

The Pacific is increasingly becoming a halfway point for transnational drug smuggling. Its island nations are hard to police and law-enforcement agencies are thinly staffed. This means it’s a haven for drug traffickers.

Albanese hopes the new initiative will combat the surge of drugs making their way into Australia: in May, Australian Federal Police (AFP) Commissioner Krissy Barrett said 17 tonnes of illicit drugs (mostly cocaine), had been seized in the Pacific since January. In all of 2025, that figure was less than 5 tonnes.

The AFP states most of the illicit drugs being trafficked to and through the Pacific are destined for Australia.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The funding sits under the Waqa Moana Initiative (named after a large, sturdy canoe) – a Pacific-led maritime security initiative to counter illicit drug trafficking.

"Drug trafficking is having a devastating impact on Pacific communities. This initiative responds to the calls of regional leaders to do more, and to step up regional coordination to address this scourge."

Beyond drug trafficking, the program also aims to address the erosion of social cohesion and ease the health burden that cocaine and methamphetamine are placing on island communities.

The first is the expansion of Australian and New Zealand outlaw motorcycle gangs into the islands — mainly the Rebels and the Head Hunters, whose members include people of Pacific Island descent from countries such as Fiji and the Cook Islands. These gang members can be a link between South American and Mexican cartels and the Pacific — a connection that barely existed ten years ago.

The second is deportation policies. Australia and New Zealand return people with criminal records to Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, the Federated States of Micronesia and the Marshall Islands after living in Australia or New Zealand. Many who arrive without support turn or return to crime.

1. The region is difficult to police. Pacific nations are scattered across roughly 25,000 islands, with about 2,000 of them inhabited. Maritime boundaries are highly porous and, in most places, subject to little or no surveillance.

Law enforcement agencies are thinly staffed, infrastructure is limited and customs and police often cannot share intelligence easily. Together, these gaps make the Pacific an attractive route for shipments bound for Australia and New Zealand.

2. Traffickers have plenty of ways in....
body.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞宣布了一项耗资 6 亿美元的计划，以加强整个太平洋地区的空中和海上监视，目标是用于在该地区运输毒品的缉毒潜艇和小型船只。 太平洋地区日益成为跨国毒品走私的中点。其岛国的治安很难，执法机构人手也很薄弱。这意味着这里是毒贩的避风港。 Albanese 希望这项新举措能够打击进入澳大利亚的毒品激增：5 月，澳大利亚联邦警察 (AFP) 局长 Krissy Barrett 表示，自 1 月以来，已在太平洋地区缉获了 17 吨非法毒品（主要是可卡因）。 2025 年全年，这个数字不到 5 吨。 法新社称，大部分贩运到太平洋地区或通过太平洋地区的非法毒品的目的地是澳大利亚。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这笔资金来自“瓦卡·莫阿纳倡议”（Waqa Moana Initiative）（以一艘坚固的大型独木舟命名）——一项由太平洋地区主导的海上安全倡议，旨在打击非法贩毒。 “毒品贩运正在对太平洋社区造成毁灭性影响。这一举措响应了地区领导人的呼吁，要求他们采取更多行动，并加强地区协调以解决这一祸害。” 除了贩毒之外，该计划还旨在解决社会凝聚力受到侵蚀的问题，并减轻可卡因和甲基苯丙胺给岛屿社区带来的健康负担。 首先是澳大利亚和新西兰的非法摩托车团伙向岛屿扩张——主要是叛军和猎头团伙，其成员包括来自斐济和库克群岛等太平洋岛国的人。这些帮派成员可能是南美和墨西哥卡特尔与太平洋地区之间的联系——这种联系在十年前几乎不存在。 二是驱逐政策。澳大利亚和新西兰将居住在澳大利亚或新西兰的有犯罪记录的人遣返回斐济、萨摩亚、汤加、密克罗尼西亚联邦和马绍尔群岛。许多在没有支持的情况下抵达的人转向或重新犯罪。 1.该地区治安难度大。太平洋国家分布在约 25,000 个岛屿上，其中约 2,000 个岛屿有人居住。海上边界漏洞百出，在大多数地方，很少或根本没有受到监视。 执法机构人手薄弱，基础设施有限，海关和警察往往无法轻松共享情报。总之，这些差距使太平洋成为前往澳大利亚和新西兰的有吸引力的货运路线。 2. 贩运者有很多方法......

reflection.en: The vastness of the Pacific Ocean and the limited resources of its island nations make them vulnerable to exploitation by transnational criminal networks. This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom of speaking up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their voices are heard and their plight addressed. May leaders and communities find the...
reflection.zh: 太平洋的浩瀚以及其岛屿国家有限的资源，使它们容易受到跨国犯罪网络的剥削。这种情况让人想起为那些不能为自己说话的人说话的古老智慧，确保他们的声音被听到，他们的困境得到解决。 愿领导者和社区找到勇气和资源，保护这些脆弱的国家免受毒品贸易的破坏性力量的侵害，维护所有人民的正义和福祉。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?
title.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心蓬勃发展——但代价是什么？

summary.en: Proponents argue that data centers will create jobs, while others express concern that they will consume significant resources with limited overall benefit.
summary.zh: 支持者认为数据中心将创造就业机会，而其他人则担心它们将消耗大量资源而整体效益有限。

body.en:
The sheer size and noise of data centres are what people tend to notice first. Some say they sound like a jet plane about to take off, others complain of a high-pitched whine.

When Lucy* puts her child to bed, she hears a constant humming. "I'll hear it and think, 'What is that? What is going on?'," she says.

And then she'll remember that the noise is a data centre just 350m (0.2 miles) from her front door in the desirable suburb of Lane Cove, in Sydney's lower north-shore. Another four are in the pipeline at the local industrial park.

Australia has quickly become a global destination for data centres, with investors attracted to the country's abundance of clean energy, natural gas reserves, and land to power and house their technologies.

Earlier this year, OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman said Australia could become a data centre capital of the world, if it wanted to.

Australia is already headed in the direction of big tech's wishes. There are 162 data centres across the country, with plans for 90 more, and an estimated more than A$155bn (£80bn) of investment money lined up.

If approved, one of the world's biggest data centres will be built in western Sydney. At one gigawatt, it is expected to be Australia's largest single energy user.

And in Marsden Park, also in western Sydney, the biggest data centre in the Southern Hemisphere is already under construction only 100m away from a local community.

But as more Australians find themselves living next door to data centres - triggering concerns about water supplies, energy use and the environment - many are asking whether joining the artificial intelligence (AI) race is worth it.

Data centres have been essential to the digital economy since the arrival of the internet.

They were originally built to process and store data for things like emails, online banking and cloud services. But everything changed after 2022 when ChatGPT launched and AI exploded in popularity. This prompted a sudden race to build more data centres to power the technology.

The location of these large, windowless buildings filled with beeping servers and cables also became important to latency – the time it takes for data to travel from its source to its destination.

Delays for things like air traffic control, robotic surgery or even Netflix would not be tolerated today, Belinda Dennett, CEO of Data Centres Australia, says.

Australia has roughly 13.6 million users of AI every month, making them the sixth most active users of the tech globally.

And experts say having data centres in Australia will lower the barrier to building more of its own AI companies.

"If we think about it in reverse, what happens if we don't build infrastructure here", Dennett says. "We get none of the value chain, we are just importing tools from someone...
body.zh: 人们往往首先注意到的是数据中心的庞大规模和噪音。有人说它们听起来像一架即将起飞的喷气式飞机，另一些人则抱怨是尖锐的哀鸣声。 当露西*让她的孩子上床睡觉时，她听到持续不断的嗡嗡声。 “我会听到它并想，‘那是什么？发生了什么事？’”她说。 然后她会记得，噪音来自距离她前门仅 350m（0.2 英里）的数据中心，该数据中心位于悉尼下北岸理想的 Lane Cove 郊区。另外四个正在当地工业园区筹备中。 澳大利亚已迅速成为全球数据中心目的地，投资者被该国丰富的清洁能源、天然气储量以及用于供电和容纳其技术的土地所吸引。 今年早些时候，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，如果澳大利亚愿意，它可以成为世界数据中心之都。 澳大利亚已经朝着大型科技公司愿望的方向前进。全国有 162 个数据中心，计划再建设 90 个，预计投资资金将超过 1,550 亿澳元（800 亿英镑）。 如果获得批准，世界上最大的数据中心之一将建在悉尼西部。预计将成为澳大利亚最大的单一能源用户，达到一吉瓦。 而在同样位于悉尼西部的马斯登公园，南半球最大的数据中心已经在建设中，距离当地社区仅 100m。 但随着越来越多的澳大利亚人发现自己住在数据中心旁边，引发了人们对供水、能源使用和环境的担忧，许多人开始质疑加入人工智能 (AI) 竞赛是否值得。 自互联网出现以来，数据中心对于数字经济至关重要。 它们最初是为了处理和存储电子邮件、网上银行和云服务等数据而构建的。但 2022 年 ChatGPT 推出、人工智能爆发式普及后，一切都发生了变化。这促使人们突然竞相建造更多数据中心来支持该技术。 这些大型、无窗的建筑物中充满了发出蜂鸣声的服务器和电缆，其位置对于延迟（数据从源传输到目的地所需的时间）也变得很重要。 澳大利亚数据中心首席执行官贝琳达·丹尼特 (Belinda Dennett) 表示，如今空中交通管制、机器人手术甚至 Netflix 等服务的延误都是不能容忍的。 澳大利亚每月约有 1360 万人工智能用户，使其成为全球第六大最活跃的技术用户。 专家表示，在澳大利亚拥有数据中心将降低建立更多自己的人工智能公司的障碍。 “如果我们反过来思考，如果我们不在这里建设基础设施，会发生什么”，丹尼特说。 “我们没有获得任何价值链，我们只是从某人那里进口工具......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers in Australia presents a complex challenge, balancing potential economic gains with environmental and resource concerns. This situation calls for careful consideration, as Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the human heart seeks knowledge and understanding, but this pursuit must be tempered with wisdom and foresight to ensure...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心的快速增长带来了复杂的挑战，需要在潜在的经济收益与环境和资源问题之间取得平衡。这种情况需要仔细考虑，正如箴言 18:15 所提醒我们的，人心寻求知识和理解，但这种追求必须以智慧和远见为辅，以确保可持续的进步。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
title.zh: 女权活动家和记者格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆去世，享年92岁

summary.en: Gloria Steinem, a prominent feminist activist and journalist who became a leader of the women's liberation movement in the US, has died at the age of 92. Her foundation announced she passed away peacefully at her New York City home, surrounded by loved ones. Steinem co-founded the Women's Action Alliance and Ms....
summary.zh: 美国女权运动的领袖之一、著名的女权活动家和记者格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆（Gloria Steinem）去世，享年92岁。她的基金会宣布，她在纽约市的家中安详离世，身边有许多爱她的人。斯泰纳姆女士是妇女行动联盟和《Ms.》杂志的联合创始人，五十多年来一直倡导妇女权利和相关议题。

body.en:
Gloria Steinem, who became a leader of the women's liberation movement in the US, has died aged 92.

In a post on Instagram, her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City on Wednesday, "surrounded by many who loved her".

Steinem, who was a writer and magazine editor, co-founded the Women's Action Alliance - a group dedicated to fighting sexism - more than 50 years ago.

She started her career as a journalist in New York and went on to co-found Ms. magazine, one of the first publications to focus on women's issues other than housekeeping and beauty.

During the 1970s, Steinem was a vocal campaigner for women's reproductive rights, among other causes.

She herself obtained an illegal abortion in London when she was 22 years old, and years later celebrated the US Supreme Court's 1973 ruling in the case of Roe v Wade, which granted women the constitutional right to abortion. Nearly half a century later she witnessed the reversal of this decision.

She also spoke out in favour of the legalisation of same-sex marriage, as well as equal rights and pay for women, and protested against the death penalty and female genital mutilation.

Born on 25 March 1934 in Toledo, Ohio, she had a difficult childhood and did not go to school full-time until she was 12 years old.

After university in the late 1950s, she went to India on a research scholarship and spent two years in a variety of roles, including helping village women organise non-violent protests against government policies, which sparked her interest in grassroots activism.

She then moved to New York City in the early 1960s to start her career as a freelance writer. Her big break came through an exposé of Playboy Bunny working conditions.

Eventually she became a columnist for New York Magazine, before founding Ms. magazine in 1972.

For years, Steinem famously eschewed marriage, but she went on to tie the knot in 2000 to David Bale, a South African-born entrepreneur-environmentalist and father of actor Christian Bale. He died three years later from brain lymphoma.

When questioned over why she changed her position on marriage, she replied: "I didn't change. Marriage changed."

In 2013, then-President Barack Obama awarded her the Presidential Medal of Freedom, the highest civilian honour in the US.

"Gloria's greatest gift was her ability to listen to others, to make others feel seen and heard. Her words, actions and example gave people permission to be their truest selves. Gloria lived true to her independent spirit, always with curiosity and a great sense of humour."

Her foundation said she lived her last years being in community and writing - welcoming guests into her home for "Talking Circles" - a tradition that will continue.

Her commitment to her home becoming a...
body.zh: 美国妇女解放运动领导人格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆 (Gloria Steinem) 去世，享年 92 岁。 她的基金会在 Instagram 上发帖称，她周三在纽约市的家中“平静地去世”，“周围有许多爱她的人”。 斯坦纳姆是一名作家和杂志编辑，50 多年前与他人共同创立了妇女行动联盟，这是一个致力于对抗性别歧视的组织。 她在纽约以记者身份开始了自己的职业生涯，后来与人共同创办了《女士》杂志，这是最早关注家务和美容以外的女性问题的出版物之一。 20 世纪 70 年代，斯泰纳姆是女性生殖权利等事业的积极倡导者。 她自己22岁时在伦敦非法堕胎，多年后庆祝美国最高法院1973年对罗伊诉韦德案的裁决，该裁决赋予妇女宪法规定的堕胎权。近半个世纪后，她目睹了这一决定的逆转。 她还公开支持同性婚姻合法化以及妇女平等权利和薪酬，并抗议死刑和女性生殖器切割。 她于 1934 年 3 月 25 日出生于俄亥俄州托莱多，童年时期很艰难，直到 12 岁才开始全日制学校。 20世纪50年代末大学毕业后，她获得研究奖学金前往印度，并在两年内担任过各种职务，包括帮助乡村妇女组织反对政府政策的非暴力抗议活动，这激发了她对草根激进主义的兴趣。 20 世纪 60 年代初，她搬到纽约，开始了自由作家的职业生涯。她的重大突破来自于揭露《花花公子兔子》的工作条件。 最终，她成为《纽约杂志》的专栏作家，并于 1972 年创办《女士》杂志。 她以回避婚姻而闻名，并于 2000 年与南非出生的企业家兼环保主义者、演员克里斯蒂安·贝尔的父亲大卫·贝尔 (David Bale) 喜结良缘。三年后，他死于脑淋巴瘤。 2013年，时任总统巴拉克·奥巴马授予她美国公民最高荣誉——总统自由勋章。 “格洛丽亚最伟大的天赋是她倾听他人的能力，让别人感到被看到和听到。她的言语、行动和榜样让人们成为最真实的自己。格洛丽亚忠于她的独立精神，总是充满好奇心和幽默感。” 她的基金会表示，她的最后几年生活在社区和写作中——欢迎客人来到她家参加“谈话圈”——这一传统将继续下去。 她致力于让自己的家成为社会正义运动的中心，以及即将出版的《意外的生活》一书，是“格洛丽亚送给世界的众多礼物之一……

reflection.en: Gloria Steinem dedicated her life to amplifying the voices of women and challenging systemic sexism. Her work, including co-founding Ms. magazine, ensured that women's issues were brought to the forefront of public discourse. As we remember her, we are reminded of the enduring call to speak for the voiceless and advocate for justice.
reflection.zh: 格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆将一生奉献给放大女性的声音，并挑战系统性的性别歧视。她的工作，包括与人合创《Ms.》杂志，确保了女性议题被推到公共讨论的前沿。当我们缅怀她时，我们被提醒要永远为无声者发声，倡导公正。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Trump's Iran strategy: Could this become a forever war?
title.zh: 特朗普的伊朗战略：这会变成一场永恒的战争吗？

summary.en: The US has launched fresh attacks on military targets in Iran, aiming to prevent Tehran from rebuilding its destroyed capabilities. However, this risks triggering a sustained downward spiral of reconstruction followed by new attacks.
summary.zh: 美国对伊朗的军事目标发动了新的袭击，旨在阻止德黑兰重建其被摧毁的能力。然而，这可能会引发一个持续的恶性循环：重建、然后是新的袭击。

body.en:
The US has launched fresh attacks on military targets in Iran. It wants to prevent Tehran rebuilding its destroyed capabilities, but risks triggering a sustained downward spiral of reconstruction followed by new attacks.

US President Donald Trump has given a fairly clear description of what the next phase of the Iran war could look like. The Iranians had tried to rebuild their radar equipment, Trump stated after the most recent wave of US strikes . "We waited until it was almost built, and then we hit it," he said.

On Tuesday, American forces once again attacked several targets in Iran . According to US Central Command (CENTCOM), the targets destroyed included "air defense sites, radar systems, maritime assets and facilities, mine laying capabilities, and communications sites."

Iran responded by firing rockets and drones at US facilities in the region. With this, the war moved on to what CENTCOM had indicated just a few days earlier could be the strategy for the next phase.

According to the news portal Axios, it was considering limited strikes, at regular intervals if necessary, to prevent Iran from reconstituting its military capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz . An American government representative used a concept from Israeli security policy to describe this idea: He called it "mowing the grass."

The metaphor refers to a strategy that doesn't even attempt to promise that an opponent will be defeated once and for all. It is enough to regularly reduce the enemy's military capabilities to the point where the threat remains manageable. When the grass grows back, you "mow" it again.

Applied to the situation in Iran, this would mean the US keeping an eye on which military capabilities the enemy is reconstituting, and attacking once it crosses a certain threshold.

In the past few months, the US has scored some military successes. US forces have significantly reduced Iran's military capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz, and have begun clearing Iranian sea mines.

However, these successes will not last. Tehran is repairing or procuring new radar installations, anti-aircraft positions and anti-ship missiles. US bombs could certainly destroy important Iranian positions with targeted strikes. But the knowledge and the industrial basis of Iranian military technology would remain.

Reconstruction can therefore be delayed, but not prevented. The US will repeatedly be confronted with the same choice: whether to accept that Tehran is regaining its capabilities, or to attack again and destroy them.

Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, warned as early as April that this development could lead to an "enduring low-intensity conflict punctuated by more intensive...
body.zh: 美国对伊朗的军事目标发动了新的袭击。它希望阻止德黑兰重建其被摧毁的能力，但有可能引发重建工作持续螺旋式下降，进而引发新的袭击。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗战争的下一阶段可能会是什么样子给出了相当明确的描述。特朗普在美国最近一波袭击后表示，伊朗人曾试图重建他们的雷达设备。 “我们一直等到它快建成了，然后我们就开始了，”他说。 周二，美军再次袭击了伊朗的多个目标。据美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）称，被摧毁的目标包括“防空站点、雷达系统、海上资产和设施、布雷能力和通信站点”。 伊朗向美国在该地区的设施发射火箭和无人机作为回应。至此，战争转向了中央司令部几天前表示的下一阶段的战略。 据新闻门户网站 Axios 报道，伊朗正在考虑进行有限的打击，并在必要时定期进行打击，以阻止伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡重建其军事能力。一位美国政府代表用以色列安全政策中的一个概念来描述这个想法：他称之为“割草”。 这个比喻指的是一种甚至不试图承诺彻底击败对手的策略。定期将敌人的军事能力降低到威胁可控的程度就足够了。当草重新长出来时，你再次“修剪”它。 应用于伊朗局势，这意味着美国密切关注敌人正在重组哪些军事能力，一旦超过一定阈值就发动攻击。 过去几个月，美国取得了一些军事胜利。美军大幅削弱了伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的军事能力，并开始清除伊朗的海雷。 然而，这些成功不会持续下去。德黑兰正在修复或采购新的雷达装置、防空阵地和反舰导弹。美国的炸弹肯定可以通过有针对性的打击摧毁伊朗的重要阵地。但伊朗军事技术的知识和工业基础将保留。 因此，重建可以被推迟，但不能被阻止。美国将反复面临同样的选择：是接受德黑兰正在恢复其能力，还是再次攻击并摧毁它们。 华盛顿战略与国际研究中心 (CSIS) 中东项目主任莫娜·雅库比安 (Mona Yacoubian) 早在 4 月份就警告称，这一事态发展可能会导致“持久的低强度冲突，其间夹杂着更激烈的……

reflection.en: The news describes a cycle of destruction and rebuilding, where each strike is met with efforts to restore capabilities, only to be targeted again. This pattern of action and reaction risks a perpetual conflict. The ancient wisdom calls us to break this cycle, not by mirroring the aggression, but by choosing a different path, seeking to overcome destructive...
reflection.zh: 新闻描述了一个破坏与重建的循环，每一次打击都伴随着恢复能力的努力，却又招致新的打击。这种反复的行动和反应模式，有陷入永久冲突的风险。古老的智慧呼唤我们打破这个循环，不是通过模仿侵略，而是选择一条不同的道路，努力用建设性的、生命肯定的行动来克服破坏性的模式。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Norway seizes Russian ship in Svalbard to compensate Ukraine
title.zh: 挪威扣押俄罗斯船只以赔偿乌克兰

summary.en: Norway has seized a Russian ship, the Professor Molchanov, under a court order obtained by Ukraine's Naftogaz. This action is a consequence of Russia's refusal to pay damages awarded to Naftogaz following Moscow's seizure of assets in Crimea in 2014. Russia has protested the seizure.
summary.zh: 挪威根据乌克兰Naftogaz公司获得的法院命令，扣押了一艘俄罗斯船只“莫尔恰诺夫教授”号。此举源于俄罗斯拒绝支付在2014年莫斯科吞并克里米亚后，被判给Naftogaz的赔偿金。俄罗斯已对此扣押提出抗议。

body.zh: 挪威当局根据 Naftogaz 在乌克兰寻求并获得的法院命令扣押了一艘俄罗斯船只“Professor Molchanov”。俄罗斯对此举表示抗议，因为俄罗斯拒绝支付 Naftogaz 的损失。 挪威法院下令在北极扣押一艘俄罗斯船只，以执行乌克兰国家能源公司 Naftogaz 在莫斯科扣押其在克里米亚（俄罗斯于 2014 年非法吞并克里米亚）的资产后赢得的 42.2 亿美元（约合 36 亿欧元）赔偿索赔的一部分。 官员们宣布，周三晚间，该船已被阻止离开位于斯瓦尔巴群岛巴伦支堡的俄罗斯煤矿定居点的港口。 斯瓦尔巴群岛自 1925 年以来一直是挪威领土，但它是一个非军事区，来自包括俄罗斯在内的数十个国家的人们可以在某些条件下免签证定居。 俄罗斯驻挪威大使表示，莫斯科将通过法律途径寻求释放该船。 第一个宣布该船被扣押的团体是代表 Naftogaz 的美国律师事务所卡温顿 (Covington)，该律师事务所试图确保海牙常设仲裁法院于 2023 年给予其赔偿。 在与乌克兰持续的战争中，俄罗斯拒绝支付罚款、法律费用和利息，Naftogaz 此后开始尝试通过当地法院扣押并强制出售俄罗斯商业资产。 Naftogaz 代理首席执行官 Sergii Fedorenko 表示：“俄罗斯不能仅仅通过拒绝遵守国际仲裁裁决来逃避责任。” 卡温顿表示，几个月来，它一直在追踪这艘名为“莫尔查诺夫教授”号的船。该公司表示，其申请周一获得了北特罗姆斯和塞尼亚地区法院的批准，该法院命令斯瓦尔巴群岛州长确保该船抵达后留在码头。 斯瓦尔巴群岛总督办公室随后发表声明，确认该船已被扣押，并将被扣押在斯瓦尔巴群岛。 声明称：“州长将与 Trust Arktikugol 合作，照顾船上的船员和乘客。”Trust Arktikugol 指的是管理巴伦支堡采矿定居点的俄罗斯企业（意为“北极煤炭”）。 与此同时，挪威司法部表示，该问题与奥斯陆政府没有直接关系。 司法部表示：“俄罗斯可以要求地区法院重新评估此案。” 俄罗斯驻挪威大使尼古拉·科尔丘诺夫周四在一份声明中表示，莫斯科将通过法律渠道寻求释放该船。 他说：“我们坚持要求立即释放该船，并确保乘客和船员的安全。” 克里姆林宫还召见挪威驻莫斯科大使，提出正式...

reflection.en: The seizure of the Professor Molchanov ship illustrates a complex legal and financial dispute stemming from geopolitical conflict. It brings to the fore the struggle for justice and compensation when international relations are strained, highlighting how past actions, like the annexation of Crimea, continue to have repercussions years later.
reflection.zh: “莫尔恰诺夫教授”号船只被扣押的事件，凸显了地缘政治冲突引发的复杂法律和金融纠纷。它将人们的注意力引向了在国际关系紧张时，为寻求正义和赔偿所做的斗争，并表明了像2014年吞并克里米亚这样的过往行为，多年后仍会产生持续的影响。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: US sanctions halt TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, disrupting study plans
title.zh: 美国制裁叫停伊朗托福和GRE考试，打乱留学计划

summary.en: Students in Iran are unable to take TOEFL and GRE exams due to the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants report that this decision jeopardizes their university application deadlines and imposes costly travel requirements.
summary.zh: 由于美国制裁豁免被暂停，伊朗学生无法参加托福和GRE考试。申请者表示，此举威胁到他们的大学申请截止日期，并增加了昂贵的旅行负担。

body.en:
Students in Iran can no longer take English-language proficiency exams after the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants say the move threatens university deadlines and adds costly travel obligations.

Iranian students hoping to study abroad are facing a new obstacle after TOEFL and GRE testing was suspended inside the country following changes to US sanctions regulations .

"My entire plan was built around taking this exam," a TOEFL candidate in Tehran told DW.

She said she had spent months preparing applications for a Ph.D. program, contacting professors and gathering documents despite internet disruptions and other challenges.

ETS, the US-based organization that administers both English-language proficiency exams, announced it suspended testing in Iran after the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) froze General License G, which had allowed certain educational services to continue in Iran .

"Following OFAC's suspension of General License G, ETS has paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately," the organization said in an official notice.

ETS added that Iranian nationals can still take the exams outside Iran and that it is exploring options to restore testing.

TOEFL is a US-based English-language proficiency test accepted by universities worldwide. The GRE is a standardized test required by some graduate programs, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Since the  Iran war  began in late February, the US has increasingly expanded sanctions targeting Iranian trade and exports, contributing to broader disruptions throughout the Iranian economy .

An Iranian institution that administered TOEFL exams told DW that new registrations had stopped following the latest sanctions changes .

The institution added that the suspension could be temporary, but no date had been given for exams to resume.

That uncertainty is particularly serious for students approaching university and scholarship deadlines who have spent months preparing and paying application-related costs.

The suspension follows earlier problems with IELTS (British equivalent of TOEFL) testing in Iran. An IELTS center in Tehran  told DW that sanctions-related difficulties transferring money had become one of the main obstacles to continuing exams.

Some Iranian applicants had already been traveling to countries such as Turkey and Armenia to take IELTS. TOEFL and GRE candidates may now have to do the same.

Alireza, who is preparing to apply to a university in Italy, said the suspension of TOEFL had disrupted a backup plan he had arranged after IELTS testing became unavailable.

"European universities usually accept IELTS. But because IELTS has been suspended in Iran, after...
body.zh: 在美国制裁豁免暂停后，伊朗的学生不能再参加托福和GRE考试。申请人表示，此举威胁到大学的最后期限，并增加了昂贵的旅行义务。希望出国留学的伊朗学生在美国制裁法规变更后，托福和GRE考试在国内暂停后面临新的障碍。“我的整个计划都是围绕着参加这次考试制定的，”德黑兰的一名托福考生告诉DW。她说，尽管互联网中断和其他挑战，她还是花了几个月的时间准备博士学位课程的申请，联系教授并收集文件。管理这两项考试的美国组织ETS宣布，在美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）冻结通用许可证G后，它暂停了在伊朗的考试，该许可证允许某些教育服务继续在伊朗进行。“在OFAC暂停通用许可证G之后， ETS已暂停在伊朗进行托福和GRE考试，立即生效，”该组织在一份官方通知中表示。ETS补充说，伊朗国民仍然可以在伊朗境外参加考试，并且正在探索恢复测试的选项。托福是全球各大学接受的美国英语水平考试。GRE也由同一个美国组织管理，是一些研究生课程要求的标准化考试，特别是在美国和加拿大。自2月下旬伊朗战争开始以来，美国越来越多地扩大针对伊朗贸易和出口的制裁，导致整个伊朗经济出现更广泛的混乱。一家管理托福考试的伊朗机构告诉德国之声，在最近的制裁变更后，新的注册已经停止。该机构补充说，暂停考试可能是暂时的，但没有给出恢复考试的日期。对于接近大学和奖学金截止日期的学生来说，这种不确定性尤其严重，他们花了数月时间准备文件，联系教授并支付与申请相关的费用。此前，伊朗雅思（英国相当于托福）考试出现了问题。德黑兰雅思考试中心告诉德国之声，与制裁有关的转账困难已成为继续考试的主要障碍之一。一些伊朗申请人已经前往土耳其和亚美尼亚等国家参加雅思考试。托福和GRE考生现在可能必须做同样的事情。准备申请意大利一所大学的Alireza表示，暂停托福考试打乱了他在雅思考试不可用后安排的备考计划。“欧洲大学通常接受雅思考试。但由于雅思考试已被暂停...

reflection.en: The suspension of TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, a consequence of US sanctions, leaves many students in a difficult position, threatening their academic timelines and forcing them to incur additional expenses. These students, who have worked diligently to prepare their applications, find their voices unheard and their futures uncertain due to decisions made...
reflection.zh: 美国制裁暂停了伊朗的托福和GRE考试，这使得许多学生陷入困境，威胁到他们的学业时间表，并迫使他们承担额外费用。这些学生辛勤准备申请材料，却发现自己的声音被忽视，未来变得不确定，这一切都源于远方的决定。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”。这段经文提醒我们要为那些机会受到不公正限制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Can Hichilema heal Zambia's political divide?
title.zh: 希奇莱马能否弥合赞比亚的政治分歧？

summary.en: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema begins his second term following a disputed election that exposed significant political divisions. His administration faces the dual challenge of unifying the nation while also addressing concerns regarding political freedoms.
summary.zh: 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马在一次有争议的选举暴露了深刻的政治分歧后，开始了第二个任期。他的政府面临着团结国家并解决对政治自由担忧的双重挑战。

body.en:
The Zambian president starts a second term after a contested election exposed deep political divisions. His challenge now is to unite the country while addressing concerns over political freedoms.

Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema was sworn in for a second five-year term on Tuesday.

For decades, Zambia has worn its peaceful transfers of power almost like a badge of honor in a region where elections have too often ended in disputed results, violence or leaders refusing to leave. Hichilema's own victory in 2021 appeared to strengthen that reputation.

Hichilema begins his second term after a disputed election , with his main challenger facing treason charges , opposition supporters questioning the credibility of the vote and controversy surrounding the closure of courts during the crucial window for election petitions.

Hichilema has promised reconciliation. But for a president who once sat on the other side of power as an opposition leader and treason suspect himself, the test now is whether those words will be matched by the political space he gives his opponents.

Ngobola Cengelo Muyembe, a political, business and social analyst, told DW that reconciliation must begin by recognizing that a significant part of the electorate backed someone else.

"You have to remember that in every 10 people that voted, four people voted for the other side," Muyembe said, noting that during the president's inaugural address, he spoke about reconciliation and uniting people. "But that message can only resonate if what is on the ground reflects what is being spoken about."

Raymond, a self-employed Zambian who asked that his full name not be used, told DW that Hichilema should look beyond who supported him at the ballot box and govern across Zambia's political and ethnic divisions.

"The president, congratulations! Don't think about people who voted for you, didn't vote for you. One Zambia, one nation, one city," Raymond said. "Real change in mines and agriculture. The mines want us Zambians to be benefiting. Even your Tonga, your Bemba, you are all Zambians."

Artist Mazuba Nzabuka told DW he also wants Hichilema to govern those who supported him and those who did not, while giving young people a greater voice.

"Going forward, he is going to do the promises left behind. He is a president for all people," said Nzabuka. "Those who did not vote for him, those who voted for him. We are the same people. The five years going forward, our voices can be heard. Look after the youths."

But reconciliation will have to contend with the political fallout from the election.

Zambia returned to multiparty democracy in 1991 and has since witnessed several changes of governing parties through elections. Hichilema himself benefited from that tradition when he defeated incumbent...
body.zh: 赞比亚总统在一场有争议的选举暴露出深刻的政治分歧后开始了第二个任期。他现在的挑战是团结国家，同时解决对政治自由的担忧。 赞比亚总统哈坎德·希奇莱马周二宣誓就职，开始第二个五年任期。 几十年来，赞比亚的和平权力移交几乎就像是一个荣誉徽章，该地区的选举经常以有争议的结果、暴力或领导人拒绝离开而告终。希奇莱马自己在 2021 年的胜利似乎强化了这一声誉。 希奇莱马在一场有争议的选举后开始了他的第二个任期，他的主要挑战者面临叛国罪指控，反对派支持者质疑投票的可信度，以及围绕选举请愿的关键窗口期间关闭法院的争议。 希奇莱马承诺和解。但对于一位曾经作为反对派领袖站​​在权力另一边并怀疑自己叛国的总统来说，现在的考验是这些话是否会与他给予对手的政治空间相匹配。 政治、商业和社会分析师恩戈博拉·森杰洛·穆延贝 (Ngobola Cengelo Muyembe) 告诉德国之声，和解必须首先认识到很大一部分选民支持其他人。 穆延贝说：“你必须记住，每 10 个人投票，就有 4 个人投票给对方。”他指出，在总统的就职演说中，他谈到了和解和团结人民。 “但只有当实际情况反映了所谈论的内容时，这一信息才能产生共鸣。” 赞比亚个体经营者雷蒙德要求不透露自己的全名，他告诉德国之声，希奇莱马应该超越投票箱中支持他的人，并跨越赞比亚的政治和种族分歧进行治理。 “总统，恭喜你！不要去想那些投票给你的人，那些没有投票给你的人。一个赞比亚，一个国家，一座城市，”雷蒙德说。 “矿山和农业发生了真正的变化。矿山希望我们赞比亚人受益。甚至你们的汤加、你们的本巴，你们都是赞比亚人。” 艺术家马祖巴·恩扎布卡 (Mazuba Nzabuka) 告诉德国之声，他还希望希奇莱马能够统治那些支持他和不支持他的人，同时让年轻人有更大的发言权。 恩扎布卡说：“展望未来，他将履行留下的承诺。他是所有人的总统。” “那些没有投票给他的人，那些投票给他的人。我们是同一个人。未来五年，我们的声音可以被听到。照顾年轻人。” 但和解必须应对选举带来的政治影响。 赞比亚于1991年恢复多党民主，此后通过选举多次更换执政党。当希奇莱马击败现任总统时，他本人也从这一传统中受益。

reflection.en: In Zambia, President Hichilema faces the daunting task of bridging deep political divides after a contentious election. The pursuit of unity and the safeguarding of political freedoms are critical for his second term, echoing the ancient wisdom that righteous rulers bring stability and hope, while the absence of justice leads to ruin.
reflection.zh: 在赞比亚，希奇莱马总统面临着在一次有争议的选举后弥合深刻政治分歧的艰巨任务。追求团结和保障政治自由对他第二个任期至关重要，这呼应了古老的智慧：公义的统治者带来稳定和希望，而缺乏公义则导致毁灭。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Clean-up begins as authorities in Nepal assess how many homes have been lost
title.zh: 尼泊尔清理工作开始，当局评估房屋损失情况

summary.en: Authorities report that thousands of homes have been destroyed, washed away, or buried under debris and mud in Nepal. Rescuers are searching for workers trapped in tunnels following a glacier collapse that caused a massive deluge.
summary.zh: 当局报告称，尼泊尔已有数千所房屋被毁、被冲走或被瓦砾和泥浆掩埋。在冰川崩塌引发大规模洪水后，救援人员正在搜寻被困在隧道中的工人。

body.en:
Nepal will have to rebuild around 20,000 houses in flood-ravaged areas, authorities said on Thursday, as rescuers continued to search for workers trapped in tunnels linked to hydropower projects and thousands remain missing after last week’s catastrophe.

A glacier collapse on 26 August sent a deluge of ice, rock and mud sweeping through the impoverished nation's border region with China, wiping out settlements and villages and leaving few houses standing and undamaged.

"Our preliminary estimates are that 7,500 houses have been completely destroyed, either washed away or buried under debris and mud," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority, told Reuters.

Even houses still standing were not habitable, Upreti said, with authorities estimating that around 20,000 houses would have to be rebuilt in different, safer locations.

At least 1,252 people were killed in Nepal last week as houses, streets and schools in towns and villages near the border with China's Tibet were swept away. More than 4,200 people are still missing and thousands more displaced.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

More than 9,300 Nepali army troops are on the ground in the affected areas of Timure in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and Nawalparasi East, coordinating search and rescue of the injured and helping with management of bodies, clearing blocked roads, and providing emergency medical treatment, an army statement said on Thursday.

An Australian medical student whose partner went missing near the Nepal-China border urged tech companies to do more to help find him and others caught up in the disaster by sharing tracking data that could narrow the search areas for rescue teams.

At least 583 foreign nationals were missing in the floods, Nepal said on Thursday, many of them pilgrims and trekkers.

An army officer who spoke on condition of anonymity as he is not authorised to speak to the media, said the search was continuing with experts from India, South Korea and China for at least 900 survivors believed to be trapped in the tunnels related to hydropower projects.

"The search-and-rescue operation will continue as long as there is any hope of finding survivors. Even if there are no survivors, we will recover the dead bodies," he said.

Army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet said two bodies had been recovered from the tunnel of Langtang Khola hydropower plant.

Australia pledged additional support and said it would also share telecommunications data with Nepali authorities.

body.zh: 尼泊尔当局周四表示，尼泊尔将不得不在遭受洪水破坏的地区重建约 20,000 所房屋，救援人员仍在继续搜寻被困在与水电项目相关的隧道中的工人，上周的灾难后仍有数千人失踪。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌，大量冰、岩石和泥浆席卷了这个贫穷国家与中国的边境地区，摧毁了定居点和村庄，几乎没有房屋完好无损。 国家减少灾害风险和管理局局长达玛·拉杰·乌普雷蒂 (Dharma Raj Upreti) 告诉路透社：“我们初步估计，有 7,500 所房屋已被完全摧毁，要么被冲走，要么被埋在废墟和泥土中。” 乌普雷蒂说，即使仍然矗立的房屋也不适合居住，当局估计大约 20,000 栋房屋必须在不同的、更安全的地点重建。 上周，尼泊尔与中国西藏接壤的边境城镇和村庄的房屋、街道和学校被冲毁，造成至少 1,252 人死亡。仍有 4,200 多人失踪，数千人流离失所。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 周四军方声明称，超过 9,300 名尼泊尔陆军士兵在拉苏瓦、努瓦科特、达丁、奇特万和纳瓦尔帕拉西东部的蒂穆雷受影响地区进行地面救援，协调伤员搜救工作，帮助处理尸体、清理堵塞的道路并提供紧急医疗救治。 一名澳大利亚医科学生的伴侣在中尼边境附近失踪，他敦促科技公司采取更多措施，通过共享跟踪数据来帮助寻找他和其他陷入灾难的人，从而缩小救援队的搜索范围。 尼泊尔周四表示，至少有 583 名外国人在洪水中失踪，其中许多是朝圣者和徒步旅行者。 一名不愿透露姓名的军官表示，来自印度、韩国和中国的专家正在继续搜寻被困在与水电项目相关的隧道中的至少 900 名幸存者。 “只要有希望找到幸存者，搜救行动就会继续下去。即使没有幸存者，我们也会打捞尸体，”他说。 陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 表示，已从 Langtang Khola 水电站隧道中找到两具尸体。 澳大利亚承诺提供额外支持，并表示还将与尼泊尔当局共享电信数据。 外媒称，中国已向尼泊尔提供第三批援助物资，包括帐篷、毛毯、医用防护服、卫星通讯设备等。

title.en: After Trump's Greenland threats, Denmark is boosting its Arctic presence with conscripts
title.zh: 在特朗普威胁格陵兰后，丹麦正通过征兵加强其北极存在

summary.en: Denmark has pledged to strengthen Arctic defenses after acknowledging years of underinvestment in the semi-autonomous territory.
summary.zh: 丹麦在承认多年来对半自治领土的投资不足后，承诺加强北极防御。

body.en:
For the first time in recent history, Danish conscripts have been deployed to Greenland, as Denmark moves to bolster its presence in the Arctic after US demands to acquire the territory.

US President Donald Trump has repeatedly sought to acquire the semi-autonomous Danish island, citing national security concerns and accusing Denmark of neglecting Arctic defence. Denmark and Greenland have firmly rejected the idea.

The conscripts are part of the first cohort under Denmark's new extended conscription program, aimed at producing soldiers capable of operating in one of the kingdom's most strategically important and challenging regions.

"It shows presence that we're here and not just thinking of our own skin. And also thinking of the people in Greenland," 19-year-old conscript David told the Reuters news agency.

Denmark has pledged billions of dollars to strengthen Arctic defences after Denmark's defence minister acknowledged years of underinvestment in the region.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Of course, we are a part of a bigger picture of the strategic communication about Greenland, but our role here is just to continue the training of the conscripts, the soldiers, and get more experience with the training in the Arctic terrain and climate," company commander captain Laura Jepsen said.

The conscripts are taking part in Arctic Endurance, a Danish military exercise that trains soldiers for combat and survival in extreme cold-weather conditions.

The drill forms part of Arctic Sentry, a NATO mission launched this year to strengthen the alliance's Arctic presence and ease tensions within NATO after Trump's remarks about Greenland.

Russia, which maintains the Arctic's largest military footprint, has criticised NATO's growing activity in the region, describing it as a direct security threat that increases the risk of confrontation.

China has increased its activity in the mineral-rich region, mostly in partnership with Russia.

Training north of the Arctic Circle, the conscripts moved through a landscape of bare rock and open expanses with no trees in sight.

"I think it sends a message that Denmark is reinforcing itself for the future," Anton, 22, one of the conscripts, said.

body.zh: 在美国要求获得格陵兰岛后，丹麦采取行动加强其在北极的存在，这是近代历史上首次将丹麦应征入伍者部署到格陵兰岛。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次以国家安全为由寻求收购这个半自治的丹麦岛屿，并指责丹麦忽视北极防御。丹麦和格陵兰岛坚决拒绝了这一想法。 这些应征入伍者是丹麦新的延长征兵计划的第一批士兵的一部分，该计划旨在培养能够在该国战略上最重要和最具挑战性的地区之一作战的士兵。 19 岁的新兵大卫告诉路透社，“这表明我们在这里，不仅仅考虑自己的皮肤。还考虑格陵兰岛的人民。” 在丹麦国防部长承认多年来对该地区的投资不足后，丹麦承诺提供数十亿美元来加强北极防御。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “当然，我们是格陵兰战略沟通大局的一部分，但我们在这里的作用只是继续对应征入伍的士兵进行训练，并在北极地形和气候下的训练中获得更多经验，”连长劳拉·杰普森上尉说。 应征入伍的士兵正在参加丹麦的“北极耐力”军事演习，训练士兵在极端寒冷的天气条件下作战和生存。 这次演习是北约今年启动的“北极哨兵”任务的一部分，旨在加强该联盟在北极的存在，并在特朗普发表有关格陵兰岛的言论后缓解北约内部的紧张局势。 俄罗斯在北极地区拥有最大的军事足迹，它批评北约在该地区日益增长的活动，称其为直接的安全威胁，增加了对抗的风险。 中国增加了在矿产丰富地区的活动，主要是与俄罗斯合作。 在北极圈以北的训练中，应征入伍者穿过一片光秃秃的岩石和一片空旷的地方，看不到任何树木。 “我认为这传达了一个信息，即丹麦正在为未来加强自身实力，”22 岁的应征入伍者之一安东说。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged all states conducting ICBM tests to provide at least 24 hours' advance...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示担忧”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了多个成员国上空。领导人敦促所有进行洲际弹道导弹试验的国家，按照国际惯例提前至少24小时发出通知。在18个论坛成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一表示反对的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

body.en:
Eight days on from the deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, rescuers were still looking for survivors who are thought to be trapped inside tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River.

At least 1,200 people have died and thousands more are missing after a "glacial collapse" high in the Himalayas, led to floodwater and debris sweeping through roads and villages. B

BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri travelled to one of the sites of one of the tunnels.

The efforts of rescuers, using rafts and drones, are a tangible expression of hope and a voice for those silenced by disaster. This echoes the ancient call to 'speak up for those who...
reflection.zh: 在毁灭性洪水灾难之后，在隧道中被困人员的紧急搜救凸显了一种深刻的人类需求：被找到并让他们的困境得到承认。救援人员使用筏子和无人机进行的搜救，是希望的有形表达，也是为那些被灾难压倒的人发出的声音。这呼应了古老的呼吁：“为不能自己说话的人说话”，确保在他们最需要的时候，没有人被遗忘。
