title.en: Bats carry dangerous viruses without getting sick. This may be why
title.zh: 蝙蝠携带危险病毒而不生病。这可能是原因

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that over 500 species of vesper bats possess two separate sets of antibody genes, a unique immune arrangement previously unknown in mammals. This remarkable system may explain how bats can tolerate numerous viruses without succumbing to serious illness.
summary.zh: 科学家发现，超过500种翼手蝠拥有两套独立的抗体基因，这种免疫结构是哺乳动物前所未见的。这一非凡的系统可能解释了蝙蝠为何能携带多种病毒而不患重病。

body.en:
Scientists have long been intrigued by a question surrounding bats: how can these flying mammals carry viruses capable of causing severe disease while rarely becoming seriously ill themselves?

Researchers at Tulane University, working with collaborators at Stanford University and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, may now have identified part of the answer.

A study published in Science Advances found that the world's largest family of bats carries two distinct copies of the genes involved in producing antibodies. These specialized proteins help the immune system identify and fight infections. Every other known mammal has only one such set of genes.

The finding gives scientists a new way to think about how immune systems evolved and how different animals respond to disease.

"We've never seen anything like this in a mammal before," said Hannah Frank, associate professor of ecology and evolutionary biology at Tulane University School of Science and Engineering and corresponding author of the study. "This completely changes our understanding of how mammalian immune systems can be organized and raises exciting new questions about why bats have been so evolutionarily successful and how they respond to viruses."

The discovery was made in vesper bats, a group that includes more than 500 species living on every continent except Antarctica. Scientists have long been interested in the extraordinary evolutionary success of these bats, and their unusual antibody system may provide part of the explanation.

Antibodies are Y-shaped proteins built from two heavy protein chains and two light protein chains. In humans and all other known mammals, the heavy chains are produced using a single set of genes.

Frank and her colleagues found that vesper bats are different. They have two separate heavy-chain gene systems, potentially giving them another way to create a wider variety of antibodies.

Researchers studying bat immunity have traditionally paid more attention to the innate immune system. Frank said the new findings show why the adaptive immune system -- the part responsible for producing antibodies -- also deserves closer study.

"We think this discovery is an important piece of the puzzle," Frank said. "It doesn't fully explain why bats are such effective viral reservoirs, but it reveals a level of immune variety we didn't know existed and gives us an entirely new direction to explore."

Bats play important ecological roles as pollinators, seed dispersers and natural pest controllers. At the same time, they are natural hosts for many viruses, Frank said.

Learning how bats can live alongside those viruses without becoming ill could eventually help researchers better understand immune responses in other species. That knowledge may also...
body.zh: 长期以来，科学家们对有关蝙蝠的一个问题很感兴趣：这些飞行的哺乳动物如何携带能够引起严重疾病的病毒，而自己却很少患上严重疾病？ 杜兰大学的研究人员与斯坦福大学和疾病控制与预防中心的合作者合作，现在可能已经找到了部分答案。 发表在《科学进展》上的一项研究发现，世界上最大的蝙蝠家族携带两个不同的参与产生抗体的基因副本。这些特殊的蛋白质帮助免疫系统识别和抵抗感染。所有其他已知的哺乳动物都只有一组这样的基因。 这一发现为科学家们提供了一种新的方式来思考免疫系统如何进化以及不同动物如何应对疾病。 杜兰大学科学与工程学院生态学和进化生物学副教授、该研究的通讯作者汉娜·弗兰克（Hannah Frank）说：“我们以前从未在哺乳动物中见过这样的情况。” “这完全改变了我们对哺乳动物免疫系统如何组织的理解，并提出了令人兴奋的新问题，即为什么蝙蝠在进化上如此成功以及它们如何对病毒做出反应。” 这一发现是在晚霞蝠中发现的，该群体包括 500 多个物种，生活在除南极洲以外的各大洲。长期以来，科学家们一直对这些蝙蝠非凡的进化成功感兴趣，它们不寻常的抗体系统可能提供了部分解释。 抗体是由两条重蛋白链和两条轻蛋白链构建的 Y 形蛋白质。在人类和所有其他已知的哺乳动物中，重链是使用一组基因产生的。 弗兰克和她的同事发现晚祷蝙蝠与众不同。它们有两个独立的重链基因系统，这可能为它们提供另一种方法来产生更广泛的抗体。 研究蝙蝠免疫的研究人员传统上更关注先天免疫系统。弗兰克说，新发现表明为什么适应性免疫系统（负责产生抗体的部分）也值得进一步研究。 “我们认为这一发现是这个难题的重要组成部分，”弗兰克说。 “它并没有完全解释为什么蝙蝠是如此有效的病毒储存库，但它揭示了我们不知道存在的免疫多样性水平，并为我们提供了一个全新的探索方向。” 蝙蝠作为传粉者、种子传播者和天然害虫控制者，发挥着重要的生态作用。弗兰克说，与此同时，它们是许多病毒的天然宿主。 了解蝙蝠如何与这些病毒共存而不生病，最终可以帮助研究人员更好地了解其他物种的免疫反应。这些知识也可能...

reflection.en: The intricate design of bats' immune systems, allowing them to carry viruses without illness, is a testament to the profound wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. Observing such biological marvels can deepen our awe and understanding of the Creator's intricate handiwork, reminding us that creation itself speaks of His intelligence and power.
reflection.zh: 蝙蝠免疫系统的复杂设计，使它们能在携带病毒的同时保持健康，这证明了雅伟创造物中蕴含的深邃智慧。观察这样的生物奇迹，可以加深我们对造物主精妙工巧的敬畏和理解，并提醒我们，创造本身就彰显着祂的智慧与大能。

title.en: One immune switch may help drive aging across the body
title.zh: 一个免疫开关可能有助于驱动全身衰老

summary.en: Aging may be partly fueled by immune cells losing their ability to clear away damaged, inflammation-promoting cells. Blocking a single receptor restored that cleanup process in mice, reducing inflammation and helping their organs, muscles, and memory remain remarkably youthful.
summary.zh: 衰老可能部分是由免疫细胞清除受损、促进炎症的细胞的能力下降所驱动的。在小鼠身上阻断一个单一的受体，恢复了这种清除过程，减少了炎症，并帮助它们器官、肌肉和记忆保持惊人的年轻状态。

body.en:
Aging happens at different speeds from one person to another, but it eventually affects everyone. New research from Stanford Medicine, conducted in mice and human cells, points to a particular failure in the immune system that may help explain why.

The researchers found that tissue-resident macrophages, a type of immune cell that lives permanently within organs, become less able with age to dispose of another class of immune cells. That decline appears to contribute to aging throughout the body.

When the scientists blocked a single receptor on these macrophages, multiple organs in mice retained more youthful characteristics. The effects were seen in the brain, heart, skeletal and heart muscle, liver, spleen, bone marrow, kidney, and colon. The receptor normally responds to a hormone involved in inflammation and pain in both mice and humans.

Disabling the receptor specifically in tissue-resident macrophages also protected mice from several problems associated with chronic inflammation and aging, including frailty, excess fat accumulation and heart trouble. Cognitive decline was substantially reduced as well, according to Katrin Andreasson, MD, the Edward F. and Irene Thiel Pimley Professor in Neurology and Neurological Sciences.

"We've been trying to figure out why we age," Andreasson said. "Now we know at least one big reason for it."

The findings are described in a paper published in Science . Andreasson is the senior author, and Jessy Tan, PhD, an instructor in neurology, is the lead author.

The results provide new insight into the important role that chronic, body-wide inflammation plays in aging and its associated health problems. They also point toward a potential drug strategy that could slow age-related deterioration in organs and possibly extend the number of years people remain healthy.

Neutrophils are the most abundant white blood cells in the immune system and serve as some of the body's most important first responders. They are produced in bone marrow and then enter the bloodstream, where they patrol for bacterial, viral, and fungal threats.

When neutrophils encounter pathogens, they can release toxic substances and even destroy themselves, spilling long strands of biological material that form web-like traps around invading microbes.

These cells do not live for long. A neutrophil may survive for as much as 24 hours, although 12 hours is more typical. Roughly 90% of circulating neutrophils eventually arrive in the liver, spleen, and bone marrow, where other immune cells remove them.

That disposal process is especially important as the body grows older. In aging animals, most neutrophils that never encounter a pathogen quickly enter senescence, a dysfunctional state in which they can release harmful chemicals that damage nearby...
body.zh: 衰老的速度因人而异，但最终会影响到每个人。斯坦福大学医学院在小鼠和人类细胞中进行的新研究指出了免疫系统的一种特殊失败，这可能有助于解释原因。 研究人员发现，组织驻留巨噬细胞是一种永久存在于器官内的免疫细胞，随着年龄的增长，其处理另一类免疫细胞的能力会逐渐减弱。这种下降似乎会导致整个身体的衰老。 当科学家们阻断这些巨噬细胞上的单个受体时，小鼠的多个器官保留了更年轻的特征。这些影响出现在大脑、心脏、骨骼和心肌、肝脏、脾脏、骨髓、肾脏和结肠中。该受体通常会对与小鼠和人类炎症和疼痛有关的激素做出反应。 使组织驻留巨噬细胞中的受体失活还可以保护小鼠免受与慢性炎症和衰老相关的多种问题，包括虚弱、脂肪堆积过多和心脏病。神经学和神经科学教授 Edward F. 和 Irene Thiel Pimley 教授 Katrin Andreasson 医学博士表示，认知能力下降也显着减少。 “我们一直在试图找出我们变老的原因，”安德烈亚森说。 “现在我们至少知道了其中一个重要原因。” 研究结果发表在《科学》杂志上的一篇论文中。 Andreasson 是资深作者，神经学讲师 Jessy Tan 博士是主要作者。 这些结果为了解慢性全身炎症在衰老及其相关健康问题中所起的重要作用提供了新的见解。他们还指出了一种潜在的药物策略，可以减缓与年龄相关的器官退化，并可能延长人们保持健康的年限。 中性粒细胞是免疫系统中最丰富的白细胞，是人体最重要的第一反应者。它们在骨髓中产生，然后进入血液，在那里巡逻细菌、病毒和真菌威胁。 当中性粒细胞遇到病原体时，它们会释放有毒物质，甚至自我毁灭，释放出长条的生物材料，在入侵的微生物周围形成网状陷阱。 这些细胞的寿命并不长。中性粒细胞可存活长达 24 小时，但更典型的是 12 小时。大约 90% 的循环中性粒细胞最终到达肝脏、脾脏和骨髓，在那里其他免疫细胞将其清除。 随着身体年龄的增长，这种处理过程尤其重要。在衰老的动物中，大多数从未遇到病原体的中性粒细胞会迅速进入衰老状态，这是一种功能失调的状态，在这种状态下，它们可以释放有害化学物质，损害附近......

title.zh: 美国参议员呼吁国家安全局就VPN使用提供指导

summary.en: A US senator has asked the National Security Agency (NSA) to provide public guidance on the best practices for using virtual private networks (VPNs) to protect communications from foreign adversaries. The senator noted the complexity and variety of VPN options available, and the NSA's previous recommendations lacked...
summary.zh: 一位美国参议员已要求国家安全局（NSA）就使用虚拟专用网络（VPN）的最佳实践向公众提供指导，以保护通信免受外国敌对势力的侵害。参议员指出，可用的VPN选项复杂且种类繁多，而NSA此前的建议缺乏关于哪些VPN能提供足够保护的具体指导。

body.en: A prominent US senator is asking the National Security Agency to provide guidance to the general public on best practices for using virtual private networks to secure their communications from spying by foreign adversaries. VPNs funnel all of a user’s Internet traffic through an encrypted connection to a remote server. The design provides strong assurances that no one between the user and the server can read the encrypted contents. VPNs also allow users to hide their IP addresses from the destination servers they communicate with. While US agencies have previously recommended use of VPNs, none have given recommendations on which ones provide adequate protection. It's all in the nuances There are a host of limitations that can undo many of the protections users may think their VPN provides them. For instance, the encrypted tunnel often terminates once a single server decrypts the traffic and sends it on to its final destination. That means the decrypted traffic or the sending and destination IP addresses may be available for snooping by rogue employees or attackers who hack the server. VPNs also don’t encrypt certain types of metadata, such as time stamps, allowing nation-states to build profiles that can be useful in intelligence gathering. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一位著名的美国参议员要求国家安全局向公众提供有关使用虚拟专用网络保护其通信免受外国对手间谍活动的最佳实践的指导。 VPN 通过加密连接将用户的所有互联网流量汇集到远程服务器。这一设计提供了强有力的保证，即用户和服务器之间的任何人都无法读取加密内容。 VPN 还允许用户向与其通信的目标服务器隐藏其 IP 地址。虽然美国机构此前建议使用 VPN，但没有一个机构就哪些 VPN 提供足够的保护给出建议。一切都在细微差别中 有许多限制可能会抵消用户认为 VPN 为他们提供的许多保护。例如，一旦单个服务器解密流量并将其发送到最终目的地，加密隧道通常就会终止。这意味着解密的流量或发送和目标 IP 地址可能会被黑客攻击服务器的流氓员工或攻击者窥探。 VPN 也不加密某些类型的元数据，例如时间戳，从而允许民族国家构建可用于情报收集的配置文件。阅读全文 评论

summary.en: A legal dispute between New Jersey and the prediction market Kalshi, concerning whether its sports-betting-like contracts are gambling or financial "swaps," has escalated to the Supreme Court. New Jersey argues Kalshi bypasses state gambling laws, while a lower court sided with Kalshi, granting jurisdiction to the...
summary.zh: 新泽西州与预测市场 Kalshi 之间的一场法律纠纷，围绕其类似体育投注的合约是赌博还是金融“掉期”展开，已升级至最高法院。新泽西州认为 Kalshi 绕过了州赌博法，而下级法院则支持 Kalshi，将管辖权授予了商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）。

body.en: New Jersey yesterday asked the Supreme Court to rule on whether states can regulate sports betting on prediction markets such as Kalshi. “Companies like Kalshi claim to offer legal sports betting in all 50 states, but they refuse to follow the gambling laws of any state," New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport said in a press release announcing the lawsuit. In April, the US Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit ruled that New Jersey cannot regulate sports bets on prediction markets. The court determined that sports-related event contracts meet the legal definition of "swaps," giving the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) exclusive jurisdiction. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 新泽西州昨天要求最高法院就各州是否可以监管卡尔希等预测市场上的体育博彩做出裁决。 “像 Kalshi 这样的公司声称在所有 50 个州提供合法的体育博彩，但他们拒绝遵守任何州的博彩法，”新泽西州总检察长 Jennifer Davenport 在宣布诉讼的新闻稿中表示。今年四月，美国第三巡回上诉法院裁定新泽西州不能监管预测市场上的体育博彩。法院认定，与体育赛事相关的合约符合“掉期”的法律定义，并赋予美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）专属管辖权。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This legal battle over how to classify financial contracts—whether as gambling or regulated "swaps"—raises questions about fairness and accountability in commerce. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide how we regulate markets and protect citizens.

This move was reportedly influenced by concerns related to the Broadcom takeover of VMware, prompting the team's CTO to seek alternative solutions for their stadium's...
summary.zh: 英格兰足球超级联赛球队托特纳姆热刺队通过将VMware的虚拟化软件更换为HPE的解决方案，大幅削减了许可费用。据报道，此举受到了VMware被博通公司收购的影响，促使该队首席技术官为其体育场的IT基础设施寻求替代方案。

body.en: Tottenham Hotspur, a professional soccer team that’s part of the Premier League, has saved over 85 percent in licensing fees by replacing its stadium's VMware instance with Hewlett-Packard Enterprise’s (HPE’s) Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) virtualization software. Tottenham hasn’t disclosed which VMware products it used or how much it previously paid the Broadcom firm. The soccer organization confirmed this week to The Register that it has moved its stadium's server, storage, and networking infrastructure to HPE solutions delivered through HPE's hybrid cloud management platform, GreenLake. That is all “underpinned by" VME and HPE's OpsRamp software for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, Rob Pickering, Tottenham's CTO, told the publication, with HPE in charge of the hybrid cloud-managed service. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 托特纳姆热刺队是英超联赛的一支职业足球队，通过使用惠普企业 (HPE) 的 Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) 虚拟化软件替换其体育场的 VMware 实例，节省了超过 85% 的许可费用。托特纳姆热刺队没有透露它使用了哪些VMware产品，也没有透露它之前向博通公司支付了多少钱。该足球组织本周向 The Register 证实，已将其体育场的服务器、存储和网络基础设施迁移到通过 HPE 混合云管理平台 GreenLake 提供的 HPE 解决方案。托特纳姆热刺队首席技术官 Rob Pickering 表示，这一切都是由 VME 和 HPE 针对混合云和多云环境的 OpsRamp 软件“支撑”的，而 HPE 则负责混合云托管服务。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the complex world of corporate mergers and technological shifts, leaders face decisions that impact their organizations' resources and operations. The CTO of Tottenham Hotspur navigated these changes by seeking a more stable and cost-effective solution, demonstrating integrity in managing the team's assets. This echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 16:12, which...
reflection.zh: 在企业合并和技术变革的复杂世界中，领导者面临着影响其组织资源和运营的决策。托特纳姆热刺队的首席技术官通过寻求更稳定、更具成本效益的解决方案来应对这些变化，这体现了其在管理球队资产方面的诚信。这呼应了《箴言》16章12节的智慧：“王因公义得治国，倚靠正直可以长久”，这表明健全、合乎道德的领导力能够带来稳定和繁荣。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?
title.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心蓬勃发展——但代价是什么？

summary.en: Proponents argue that data centers will create jobs, while others express concern that they will consume significant resources with limited overall benefit.
summary.zh: 支持者认为数据中心将创造就业机会，而其他人则担心它们将消耗大量资源而整体效益有限。

body.en:
The sheer size and noise of data centres are what people tend to notice first. Some say they sound like a jet plane about to take off, others complain of a high-pitched whine.

When Lucy* puts her child to bed, she hears a constant humming. "I'll hear it and think, 'What is that? What is going on?'," she says.

And then she'll remember that the noise is a data centre just 350m (0.2 miles) from her front door in the desirable suburb of Lane Cove, in Sydney's lower north-shore. Another four are in the pipeline at the local industrial park.

Australia has quickly become a global destination for data centres, with investors attracted to the country's abundance of clean energy, natural gas reserves, and land to power and house their technologies.

Earlier this year, OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman said Australia could become a data centre capital of the world, if it wanted to.

Australia is already headed in the direction of big tech's wishes. There are 162 data centres across the country, with plans for 90 more, and an estimated more than A$155bn (£80bn) of investment money lined up.

If approved, one of the world's biggest data centres will be built in western Sydney. At one gigawatt, it is expected to be Australia's largest single energy user.

And in Marsden Park, also in western Sydney, the biggest data centre in the Southern Hemisphere is already under construction only 100m away from a local community.

But as more Australians find themselves living next door to data centres - triggering concerns about water supplies, energy use and the environment - many are asking whether joining the artificial intelligence (AI) race is worth it.

Data centres have been essential to the digital economy since the arrival of the internet.

They were originally built to process and store data for things like emails, online banking and cloud services. But everything changed after 2022 when ChatGPT launched and AI exploded in popularity. This prompted a sudden race to build more data centres to power the technology.

The location of these large, windowless buildings filled with beeping servers and cables also became important to latency – the time it takes for data to travel from its source to its destination.

Delays for things like air traffic control, robotic surgery or even Netflix would not be tolerated today, Belinda Dennett, CEO of Data Centres Australia, says.

Australia has roughly 13.6 million users of AI every month, making them the sixth most active users of the tech globally.

And experts say having data centres in Australia will lower the barrier to building more of its own AI companies.

"If we think about it in reverse, what happens if we don't build infrastructure here", Dennett says. "We get none of the value chain, we are just importing tools from someone...
body.zh: 人们往往首先注意到的是数据中心的庞大规模和噪音。有人说它们听起来像一架即将起飞的喷气式飞机，另一些人则抱怨是尖锐的哀鸣声。 当露西*让她的孩子上床睡觉时，她听到持续不断的嗡嗡声。 “我会听到它并想，‘那是什么？发生了什么事？’”她说。 然后她会记得，噪音来自距离她前门仅 350m（0.2 英里）的数据中心，该数据中心位于悉尼下北岸理想的 Lane Cove 郊区。另外四个正在当地工业园区筹备中。 澳大利亚已迅速成为全球数据中心目的地，投资者被该国丰富的清洁能源、天然气储量以及用于供电和容纳其技术的土地所吸引。 今年早些时候，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，如果澳大利亚愿意，它可以成为世界数据中心之都。 澳大利亚已经朝着大型科技公司愿望的方向前进。全国有 162 个数据中心，计划再建设 90 个，预计投资资金将超过 1,550 亿澳元（800 亿英镑）。 如果获得批准，世界上最大的数据中心之一将建在悉尼西部。预计将成为澳大利亚最大的单一能源用户，达到一吉瓦。 而在同样位于悉尼西部的马斯登公园，南半球最大的数据中心已经在建设中，距离当地社区仅 100m。 但随着越来越多的澳大利亚人发现自己住在数据中心旁边，引发了人们对供水、能源使用和环境的担忧，许多人开始质疑加入人工智能 (AI) 竞赛是否值得。 自互联网出现以来，数据中心对于数字经济至关重要。 它们最初是为了处理和存储电子邮件、网上银行和云服务等数据而构建的。但 2022 年 ChatGPT 推出、人工智能爆发式普及后，一切都发生了变化。这促使人们突然竞相建造更多数据中心来支持该技术。 这些大型、无窗的建筑物中充满了发出蜂鸣声的服务器和电缆，其位置对于延迟（数据从源传输到目的地所需的时间）也变得很重要。 澳大利亚数据中心首席执行官贝琳达·丹尼特 (Belinda Dennett) 表示，如今空中交通管制、机器人手术甚至 Netflix 等服务的延误都是不能容忍的。 澳大利亚每月约有 1360 万人工智能用户，使其成为全球第六大最活跃的技术用户。 专家表示，在澳大利亚拥有数据中心将降低建立更多自己的人工智能公司的障碍。 “如果我们反过来思考，如果我们不在这里建设基础设施，会发生什么”，丹尼特说。 “我们没有获得任何价值链，我们只是从某人那里进口工具......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers in Australia presents a complex challenge, balancing potential economic gains with environmental and resource concerns. This situation calls for careful consideration, as Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the human heart seeks knowledge and understanding, but this pursuit must be tempered with wisdom and foresight to ensure...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心的快速增长带来了复杂的挑战，需要在潜在的经济收益与环境和资源问题之间取得平衡。这种情况需要仔细考虑，正如箴言 18:15 所提醒我们的，人心寻求知识和理解，但这种追求必须以智慧和远见为辅，以确保可持续的进步。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Just like a fruit fly, a new algorithm never forgets old scents
title.zh: 就像果蝇一样，新算法永不忘记旧气味

summary.en: An insect-inspired algorithm uses "sparse coding" to learn quickly and retain scent memories long-term, overcoming the limitations of current electronic noses which tend to forget odors after learning new ones. This approach mimics the sophisticated olfactory processing of fruit flies, despite their small brains.
summary.zh: 受昆虫启发的算法采用“稀疏编码”技术，能够快速学习并长期保留气味记忆，克服了当前电子鼻容易在学习新气味时忘记旧气味的局限性。这种方法模仿了果蝇尽管大脑很小却能进行复杂的嗅觉处理。

body.en: Fruit flies aren't exactly famous for their brainpower; you've probably drowned more than one in a wine glass left too long on the patio table. And yet, working with roughly 140,000 neurons—a brain smaller than a poppy seed— Drosophila can sort through a huge range of smells in a fraction of a second, and then retain the memory of that scent for a long time. In this, they do much better than current "electronic noses." Even the most advanced ones on the market tend to be expensive, painfully narrow in what they can detect, and quick to forget an odor the moment they learn a new one. So why not just copy the fly? That's the question a growing number of researchers have been asking—including Kevin Max and Yang Shen at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology, whose new algorithm, Spi-Fly, is described in a paper recently published in the journal Neuromorphic Computing and Engineering. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 果蝇并不以其聪明才智而闻名。您可能已经在露台桌子上放置太久的酒杯中淹死了不止一个。然而，通过与大约 140,000 个神经元（比罂粟种子还小的大脑）合作，果蝇可以在几分之一秒内对大量气味进行分类，然后长时间保留该气味的记忆。在这方面，它们比目前的“电子鼻”做得更好。即使是市场上最先进的产品也往往价格昂贵，能够检测到的气味也非常有限，而且一旦学会一种新的气味，很快就会忘记。那么为什么不直接复制苍蝇呢？这是越来越多的研究人员一直在问的问题，其中包括冲绳科学技术研究所的 Kevin Max 和 Yang Shen，他们的新算法 Spi-Fly 在最近发表在《神经形态计算与工程》杂志上的一篇论文中进行了描述。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The remarkable scent-processing capabilities of fruit flies, despite their tiny brains, inspire new technological advancements. This reminds us that wisdom and understanding are often revealed through careful observation of the natural world, a creation that speaks volumes about its Maker's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 果蝇尽管大脑微小，却拥有惊人的气味处理能力，这启发了新的技术进步。这提醒我们，智慧和理解常常通过对自然世界的仔细观察而显现，而这创造本身就充分彰显了其创造者的非凡智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Four major AI models suffer rare overlapping downtime
title.zh: 四大主要人工智能模型遭遇罕见重叠宕机

summary.en: Service interruptions hit ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini practically simultaneously, affecting users of these major AI platforms.
summary.zh: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 和 Gemini 的服务中断几乎同时发生，影响了这些主要人工智能平台的用户。

body.en: Cloud-based AI models operated by OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google suffered a rare and overlapping set of significant service interruptions over a period of hours Thursday morning. Anthropic first reported a "partial outage" related to "elevated errors on requests to Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5" at 9:23 am (all times Eastern). The company reported that it had "identified the cause" of the error roughly 15 minutes later, before reporting that "a fix has been deployed" and the issue was resolved by 12:16 pm. A separate incident report indicated "elevated errors on requests to Claude Sonnet 5" for a brief period just after noon. OpenAI, meanwhile, reported "elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex" were resulting in "degraded performance" as of 10:43 am Thursday morning. A mitigation put in place a little more than half an hour later led to the issue being marked as "resolved" by 12:55 pm. Read full article Comments
body.zh: OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI 和 Google 运营的基于云的人工智能模型在周四上午的几个小时内遭遇了罕见且重叠的严重服务中断。 Anthropic 于上午 9:23（均为东部时间）首次报告了与“对 Claude Mythos 5.1、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5 的请求错误增加”相关的“部分中断”。该公司报告称，大约 15 分钟后，它“确定了错误的原因”，然后报告“已部署修复程序”，问题在中午 12 点 16 分得到解决。另一份事件报告指出，中午过后的短时间内，“对克劳德十四行诗 5 的请求错误增多”。与此同时，OpenAI 报告称，截至周四上午 10 点 43 分，“ChatGPT 和 Codex 的错误增加”导致“性能下降”。半个多小时后采取的缓解措施导致该问题在中午 12:55 之前被标记为“已解决”。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The interconnectedness and simultaneous failure of major AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini serve as a stark reminder of how rapidly our technological landscape is evolving. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a prophecy that resonates deeply with the current era of accelerated technological advancement and its...
reflection.zh: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 和 Gemini 等主要人工智能平台的同时宕机，凸显了我们技术格局的快速演变。但以理书 12:4 预言末世知识必增长，这与当前技术加速发展及其复杂、有时脆弱的系统产生了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Hundreds gather to urge Scottish government to pause datacentre boom
title.zh: 数百人聚集敦促苏格兰政府暂停数据中心热潮

summary.en: Opposition is mounting as at least 20 datacentre projects are proposed in Scotland, including one in Fife that is being billed as the second largest in the world. Hundreds gathered in Edinburgh to call for an immediate moratorium on this expansion.
summary.zh: 苏格兰至少有20个数据中心项目被提议，其中包括一个号称是世界第二大的项目，反对声音日益高涨。数百人聚集在爱丁堡，呼吁立即暂停这一扩张。

body.en: Opposition mounts as at least 20 projects proposed, including one in Fife billed as second largest in world Kat Jones may be the closest thing Scotland has to Erin Brockovich in 2026. Standing in the shadow of Arthur’s Seat outside Holyrood, the 52-year-old is revving up the crowd of protesters around her. “Who is here from Lammermuir? Ayrshire? What about Aberdeen?” she calls to the crowd. On Thursday, hundreds travelled to Edinburgh to call for an immediate moratorium on Scotland’s datacentre boom, which includes one project in Auchtertool, Fife, that has been billed as the second largest in the world. Continue reading...
body.zh: 至少有 20 个拟议项目遭到反对，其中包括号称世界第二大的法夫郡的一个项目。凯特·琼斯 (Kat Jones) 可能是 2026 年苏格兰最接近艾琳·布罗科维奇 (Erin Brockovich) 的项目。这位 52 岁的女士站在荷里路德外亚瑟王宝座的阴影下，让周围的抗议者兴奋不已。 “谁来自拉默缪尔？艾尔郡？阿伯丁呢？”她向人群喊道。周四，数百人前往爱丁堡，呼吁立即暂停苏格兰数据中心的繁荣，其中包括位于法夫郡奥赫特图尔​​的一个项目，该项目被誉为世界第二大数据中心。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for a pause on Scotland's datacentre boom, led by activists like Kat Jones, echoes the ancient cry for justice and righteousness. When systems prioritize rapid growth over ecological or community well-being, the prophetic voice calls for a halt, demanding that justice roll down like waters. May this moment of protest lead to a more balanced and...
reflection.zh: 由卡特·琼斯等活动家领导的呼吁暂停苏格兰数据中心热潮的行动，呼应了古老的对公义和正直的呼求。当系统优先考虑快速增长而非生态或社区福祉时，先知的呼声要求停止，并要求公义如水滚滚。”愿这一抗议时刻能带来一个更平衡、更可持续的方法。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Nvidia to buy developer platform Hugging Face in $12.9bn deal
title.zh: 英伟达以129亿美元收购开发者平台Hugging Face

summary.en: Semiconductor giant Nvidia is set to acquire the popular developer platform Hugging Face for nearly $13 billion. This move signals Nvidia's bet that supporting open AI models could help offset a potential slowdown in demand for its chips.
summary.zh: 半导体巨头英伟达将以近130亿美元收购流行的开发者平台Hugging Face。此举表明英伟达押注支持开放人工智能模型将有助于抵消其芯片需求可能放缓的影响。

body.en: Semi-conductor giant bets that support for open AI models could offset potential slowdown in demand for chips Nvidia will buy the popular developer platform Hugging Face for nearly $13bn, betting that support for ⁠open AI models could offset a potential slowdown in demand for the semiconductor giant’s chips. Shares ⁠in Nvidia were ⁠slightly lower ​after the $12.93bn (£9.57bn) deal – which ranks among its biggest ever – was announced for the database of AI models on Thursday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 半导体巨头押注对开放人工智能模型的支持可以抵消芯片需求潜在放缓的影响 英伟达将以近 130 亿美元收购流行的开发者平台 Hugging Face，押注对开放人工智能模型的支持可以抵消对半导体巨头芯片需求潜在放缓的影响。周四宣布了 129.3 亿美元（95.7 亿英镑）的人工智能模型数据库交易，该交易是有史以来最大的一笔交易，之后英伟达的股价小幅下跌。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence, exemplified by Nvidia's acquisition of Hugging Face, echo the prophecy that 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). As AI capabilities expand, we are called to pursue this knowledge with wisdom and ethical consideration, ensuring it serves humanity's good.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展和广泛应用，以英伟达收购Hugging Face为例，呼应了“知识将增长”（但以理书12:4）的预言。随着人工智能能力的扩展，我们被呼召以智慧和伦理考量来追求这些知识，确保它们服务于人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Nvidia strikes $12.9bn deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face
title.zh: 英伟达斥资129亿美元收购AI平台Hugging Face

summary.en: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a prominent AI platform and developer community, for approximately $12.9 billion. This acquisition signifies Nvidia's expansion into software and its move to control a significant open-source AI ecosystem.
summary.zh: 英伟达已同意以约129亿美元的价格收购领先的人工智能平台和开发者社区Hugging Face。此次收购标志着英伟达向软件领域的扩张，并获得了对一个重要的开源人工智能生态系统的控制权。

body.en:
Nvidia has agreed to buy artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face in a deal valued at about $12.9bn (£9.5bn), one of the AI chipmaker's biggest acquisitions as it expands into software.

Hugging Face, founded in 2016, has become a popular online platform where developers and researchers can find, share and test AI models and tools.

It recently made headlines after rogue AI agents that escaped a testing environment appeared on its platform, raising questions about AI safety and oversight.

The deal would bring one of the world's largest AI developer communities into Nvidia and give it control of a leading open-source platform - an alternative to systems offered by OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia is best known for making the advanced chips used to train and run AI systems. Demand for those chips has surged as companies race to build AI products.

The companies already work together to help developers use Nvidia's computing services through the platform.

According to the companies, Hugging Face is used by more than 18 million developers and hosts more than three million AI models. More than 200,000 companies use the platform, they said.

Nvidia said Hugging Face would remain open to developers and that users would not be required to use its chips or services.

Under the agreement, Nvidia will pay about $11.9bn to Hugging Face investors and offer up to $1bn in stock-based incentives to employees who join the company.

The deal could also help Nvidia expand its presence in AI software as some of its biggest customers, including Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI, develop their own chips.

Open-source AI models can be downloaded and adapted by users, unlike many AI systems that are controlled by a single company.

Supporters say the approach can make the technology more accessible to businesses, researchers and developers.

Yaël Ossowski, deputy director of advocacy group Consumer Choice Center, said the acquisition was "a vote of confidence in open AI" and suggested it could encourage competition by making AI tools more widely available to start ups and smaller companies.

The deal will be a "major victory for innovators and consumers worldwide" if Nvidia keeps Hugging Face open and accessible, he added.

The deal would also give Nvidia access to one of the world's largest AI developer communities as competition in the sector intensifies .

Founded by French entrepreneurs Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf, Hugging Face also provides datasets, software tools and cloud services used to build AI applications.
body.zh: 英伟达已同意收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，交易价值约 129 亿美元（合 95 亿英镑），这是这家人工智能芯片制造商向软件领域扩张的最大收购案之一。 Hugging Face 成立于 2016 年，现已成为一个流行的在线平台，开发人员和研究人员可以在其中查找、共享和测试人工智能模型和工具。 最近，在其平台上出现了逃离测试环境的流氓人工智能代理后，该公司成为了头条新闻，引发了有关人工智能安全和监督的质疑。 这笔交易将把世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一引入英伟达，并使其控制领先的开源平台——这是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 提供的系统的替代品。 Nvidia 以制造用于训练和运行人工智能系统的先进芯片而闻名。随着公司竞相开发人工智能产品，对这些芯片的需求激增。 两家公司已经合作，帮助开发人员通过该平台使用 Nvidia 的计算服务。 据两家公司称，Hugging Face 已被超过 1800 万开发者使用，并托管超过 300 万个人工智能模型。他们表示，超过 20 万家公司使用该平台。 英伟达表示，Hugging Face 将继续向开发者开放，并且不会要求用户使用其芯片或服务。 根据协议，英伟达将向 Hugging Face 投资者支付约 119 亿美元，并向加入该公司的员工提供高达 10 亿美元的股票激励。 这笔交易还可以帮助英伟达扩大其在人工智能软件领域的影响力，因为包括微软、Meta 和 OpenAI 在内的一些最大客户都在开发自己的芯片。 与许多由单个公司控制的人工智能系统不同，开源人工智能模型可以由用户下载和调整。 支持者表示，这种方法可以使企业、研究人员和开发人员更容易使用该技术。 倡导组织消费者选择中心副主任 Yaël Ossowski 表示，此次收购是“对开放人工智能的信任票”，并表示它可以通过让初创企业和小公司更广泛地使用人工智能工具来鼓励竞争。 他补充说，如果英伟达保持 Hugging Face 的开放性和可访问性，这笔交易将是“全球创新者和消费者的重大胜利”。 随着该行业竞争的加剧，这笔交易还将使英伟达能够进入世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一。 Hugging Face 由法国企业家 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond 和 Thomas Wolf 创立，还提供用于构建人工智能应用程序的数据集、软件工具和云服务。

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in artificial intelligence, is a hallmark of our time. This acquisition by Nvidia underscores the immense value and potential seen in AI platforms like Hugging Face, which serve as hubs for innovation and collaboration among developers. As we witness this explosion of knowledge, it calls us to consider its...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速发展，尤其是在人工智能领域，是我们这个时代的标志。英伟达的此次收购凸显了像Hugging Face这样的人工智能平台所蕴含的巨大价值和潜力，它们是开发者创新与协作的中心。当我们见证知识的爆炸式增长时，这促使我们思考其目的和伦理应用，在技术进步的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

This practice of curating our mental environment aligns with the wisdom of filling our thoughts with things that are good and...
reflection.zh: 在这个充斥着持续数字噪音的时代，电子阅读器为专注阅读提供了一个避难所。它让我们能够有意识地选择占据我们思想的内容，避开那些分散我们注意力的不间断提醒。这种管理我们思想环境的做法，与用良善和平安稳固我们思想的智慧相符。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

Our choices, like opting for fans over aircon, can reflect a care for this good creation, avoiding further harm from fossil fuels that contribute to the...

Initially, it has 15 autonomous vehicles with...

body.en:
Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday - the company is the first to launch the service.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

At the moment, the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

The BBC's Zoe Kleinman was the first British journalist to hail a self-driving Uber in London - here's how the ride went.
body.zh: 优步周四推出了自动驾驶小型出租车，伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国第一辆机器人出租车出行——该公司是第一家推出这项服务的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 BBC 的佐伊·克莱曼 (Zoe Kleinman) 是第一位在伦敦称赞自动驾驶 Uber 的英国记者 - 以下是乘坐过程。

reflection.en: The rollout of self-driving taxis in London marks a significant leap in technological advancement, bringing science fiction closer to reality. As Daniel prophesied, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This innovation promises convenience and efficiency, yet it also prompts reflection on how we integrate such powerful tools into our...
reflection.zh: 自动驾驶出租车在伦敦的推出标志着技术进步的重大飞跃，使科幻小说更接近现实。正如但以理所预言的，“许多人来往奔走，知识就必增长。”这项创新带来了便利和效率，但它也促使我们反思如何将如此强大的工具融入我们的生活和社会。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.

title.en: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
title.zh: 优步推出英国首款带司机的机器人出租车——乘坐体验如何

summary.en: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
summary.zh: 网约车应用已推出15辆自动驾驶出租车，但车内配有安全员。

body.en:
Londoners are able to hail the UK's first robotaxis - as Uber today becomes the first company to launch a self-driving minicab.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

Uber said it surveyed London-based customers via the app and more than 100,000 said they would choose a self-driving taxi if one was available, despite incidents of driverless rides malfunctioning in US cities where they already operate.

As I found out when I became the first UK journalist to hail one, it was mostly smooth but the safety driver did intervene on one occasion.

At the moment the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

Taking a self-driving ride will only appear as an option in the app after the journey has been booked, and if one of its cars is available nearby.

Uber's global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia said the plan was to phase them in over a period of several years.

"We always want consumers to be able to request a human ride or an autonomous vehicle, and because the market's growing, we expect that there will be human drivers on Uber London for a long time to come," he said.

The Ford Mustang electric vehicles which make up Uber's current small fleet are fitted with the UK tech firm Wayve's driverless car technology, which uses AI to analyse data about what is going on around it in real time, gathered by sensors in a bar on the roof of the vehicle and elsewhere.

The vehicles are not pre-programmed - their actions are determined on the spot depending on what is going on.

Google's autonomous car company Waymo and the Chinese tech giant Baidu are also vying to launch services in the UK, and the competition is fierce.

Wayve chief executive Alex Kendall described developing the technology as "the space race for our generation" but added there were some "really hard problems to solve" along the way.

"What we've done over time is pioneer a completely new approach to autonomous driving, making it possible to bring this to a busy and complex city like London and scale it globally," he said.

This week I became the first British journalist to travel as a customer in a self-driving Uber after hailing one via the app.

The safety driver gave me a 30-second safety briefing, and then we were off, making our way down the busy streets of central London.

For several minutes, we negotiated the traffic without incident, cruising past a busy Brexit demonstration under way outside parliament, successfully navigating traffic lights and roadworks along the way.

When a cyclist paused and waved...
body.zh: 伦敦人可以欢呼英国第一辆机器人出租车——优步今天成为第一家推出自动驾驶小型出租车的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 Uber 表示，它通过该应用程序对伦敦的客户进行了调查，超过 10 万名客户表示，如果有自动驾驶出租车，他们会选择自动驾驶出租车，尽管他们已经在美国城市运营的无人驾驶出租车出现了故障。 当我成为第一个向安全司机欢呼的英国记者时发现，一切都很顺利，但安全司机确实有一次进行了干预。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 只有在预订行程后，并且附近有一辆自驾车辆可用时，乘坐自驾游才会作为一个选项出现在应用程序中。 Uber 自动驾驶移动和配送全球主管 Sarfraz Maredia 表示，该计划将在几年内分阶段实施。 他说：“我们一直希望消费者能够要求有人乘坐或自动驾驶汽车，而且由于市场不断增长，我们预计 Uber London 将在未来很长一段时间内有人类司机。” 构成 Uber 目前小型车队的福特野马电动汽车配备了英国科技公司 Wayve 的无人驾驶汽车技术，该技术使用人工智能来实时分析周围发生的情况的数据，这些数据由车辆顶部酒吧和其他地方的传感器收集。 这些车辆没有预先编程——它们的行动是根据发生的情况当场决定的。 谷歌旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo和中国科技巨头百度也竞相在英国推出服务，竞争非常激烈。 Wayve 首席执行官亚历克斯·肯德尔 (Alex Kendall) 将开发这项技术描述为“我们这一代人的太空竞赛”，但他补充说，在此过程中存在一些“真正难以解决的问题”。 他说：“随着时间的推移，我们所做的是开创一种全新的自动驾驶方法，使其能够将其引入伦敦这样繁忙而复杂的城市，并在全球范围内推广。” 本周，我通过应用程序叫了一辆自动驾驶优步车，成为第一位乘坐自动驾驶优步车出行的英国记者。 安全司机给我做了 30 秒的安全简报，然后我们就出发了，沿着伦敦市中心繁忙的街道行驶。 在几分钟的时间里，我们顺利通过了交通，驶过议会外正在进行的繁忙的脱欧示威活动，成功地通过了沿途的红绿灯和道路施工。 当一个骑自行车的人停下来挥手时......

reflection.en: Uber's introduction of robotaxis in London, even with safety drivers, marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle technology. As this new venture unfolds, the company and its employees might consider committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and safety in this innovative endeavor. May their work be guided by...
reflection.zh: 优步在伦敦推出机器人出租车，即使配备安全员，也标志着自动驾驶技术的重要一步。随着这项新事业的展开，公司及其员工或许会考虑将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期在这项创新事业中取得成功和安全。愿他们的工作以智慧为指导，并致力于为公众提供良好服务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Razed by wildfire, erased by USPS: Hawaiians fight to restore mail delivery

Adding to their trauma, the USPS had 'eliminated' the addresses of these rebuilt homes, while unburned houses continued to receive mail, leaving victims struggling to restore basic...

body.en: Wildfire victims rebuilt their homes in Lahaina only to find USPS had ‘eliminated’ their addresses – while houses that didn’t burn receive mail as normal Two months after a devastating wildfire whipped through Lahaina in August 2023, Pam Reader was allowed back to see what was left of her home. With a heavy heart, she returned to the Hawaiian oceanside town now filled with endless blocks of burned houses. As she rounded her corner, she saw the only thing remaining was her bright turquoise mailbox. “It was an old crappy mailbox,” Reader said. “It was metal, though, which is why I think it survived.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 野火受害者在拉海纳重建家园，却发现美国邮政局“删除”了他们的地址，而没有被烧毁的房屋却能正常收到邮件。2023 年 8 月，一场毁灭性的野火席卷了拉海纳，两个月后，帕姆·里德被允许返回查看她家中剩下的东西。她怀着沉重的心情回到了夏威夷海滨小镇，现在这里到处是一望无际的被烧毁的房屋。当她拐过街角时，她看到唯一剩下的就是她明亮的绿松石色邮箱。 “这是一个破旧的邮箱，”雷德说。 “不过，它是金属的，这就是我认为它幸存下来的原因。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Lahaina wildfires, victims faced the daunting task of rebuilding, only to encounter a new hurdle: the elimination of their addresses by the USPS. This bureaucratic oversight left them struggling to restore essential services, highlighting the need to advocate for those whose voices are often lost in disaster recovery. We are called...
reflection.zh: 在拉海纳野火灾难之后，受灾者面临着重建家园的艰巨任务，却又遇到了新的障碍——美国邮政服务公司取消了他们的地址。这种官僚上的疏忽使他们在恢复基本服务方面举步维艰，这凸显了在灾后重建过程中为那些声音常常被忽视的人们发声的必要性。我们蒙召要为无声者发声，确保那些已失去许多的人不被本应服务于他们的系统进一步边缘化。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Ebola outbreak underscores food insecurity crisis in DRC
title.zh: 埃博拉疫情加剧刚果（金）粮食不安全危机

summary.en: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has caused over 3,000 deaths and twice as many cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Concurrently, approximately 26 million people in the region face a food insecurity crisis, which exacerbates the spread and lethality of the virus, as hunger and disease are described as "old...
summary.zh: 在刚果（民主共和国），由邦迪布吉奥（Bundibugyo）埃博拉病毒引起的疫情已导致超过3000人死亡，报告病例数是死亡人数的两倍以上。与此同时，该地区约有2600万人正经历粮食不安全危机，这加剧了病毒的传播和致命性，正如世界卫生组织总干事所言，“饥饿与疾病是老友”。

body.en: The recent Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the virus has reportedly claimed more than 3,000 lives, and more than twice as many reported cases, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. At the same time, analysts warn that roughly 26 million people across the region are experiencing a food insecurity crisis, a compounding factor that increases both the spread and lethality of the virus. “Hunger and disease are old companions,” Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, director-general of the World Health Organization, said in a statement referring to the outbreak. “People weakened by hunger are far more vulnerable to infections.” Ebola weakens the immune system, making it more difficult for the body to fight the disease and recover once infected. Healthy food can both support an immune system response and improve conditions for medications to work properly, thus accelerating recovery, Grace Kwakezime Mongame, emergency nutritionist at the World Food Programme in DRC, told Mongabay in a call. A lack of reliable food can force people out of their homes where they potentially spread or contract the disease from others in the community. “Since the disease is transmitted through contact, moving around risks creating new layers of infection; the aim is to keep people within a single environment, Kwakezime said. WFP also provides food to patients’ families, especially dependent children, so the sick can rest and recover instead of leaving isolation to care for their dependents. The need for food can also…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 据美国疾病控制与预防中心称，最近由本迪布焦病毒株引起的埃博拉疫情在刚果民主共和国造成了 3,000 多人死亡，报告病例数是报告病例数的两倍多。与此同时，分析人士警告称，该地区约 2600 万人正在经历粮食不安全危机，这一复杂因素加剧了病毒的传播和致命性。世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞在一份声明中谈到此次疫情时表示：“饥饿和疾病是老伴。” “因饥饿而虚弱的人更容易受到感染。”埃博拉病毒会削弱免疫系统，使身体更难抵抗疾病并在感染后恢复。刚果民主共和国世界粮食计划署紧急营养师 Grace Kwakezime Mongame 在电话中告诉 Mongabay，健康食品既可以支持免疫系统反应，又可以改善药物正常发挥作用的条件，从而加速康复。缺乏可靠的食物可能会迫使人们离开家，他们可能会从社区中的其他人那里传播或感染疾病。 Kwakezime 说：“由于这种疾病是通过接触传播的，走动有可能造成新的感染层；目的是让人们呆在一个单一的环境中。粮食计划署还向患者家属，特别是受抚养的儿童提供食物，这样病人就可以休息和康复，而不是离开隔离来照顾他们的家属。对食物的需求也可以......本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The news from the Democratic Republic of Congo paints a stark picture of how hunger and disease intertwine, making vulnerable populations even more susceptible to deadly outbreaks like Ebola. The WHO director's observation that "hunger and disease are old companions" underscores the urgent need for practical compassion, sharing our resources to alleviate...
reflection.zh: 来自刚果（民主共和国）的消息描绘了一幅严峻的图景，说明了饥饿与疾病如何交织在一起，使弱势群体更容易感染埃博拉等致命疫情。世界卫生组织总干事关于“饥饿与疾病是老友”的说法，凸显了实际怜悯的紧迫性，即分享我们的资源以减轻痛苦。当我们满足饥饿者的基本需求时，我们也增强了他们抵御其他危机的能力。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Minister tells Brits to stock up on days of supplies after ‘supersize’ El Niño warning
title.zh: 部长告诫英国人储备数日物资，因‘超级巨型’厄尔尼诺预警

summary.en: Exclusive: Angela Eagle urges people to be ‘a bit more resilient’ as she tells UK citizens to plan for national emergencies. British people have been urged to have enough food and water on hand to survive a few days without power or water, as the UN said the El Niño climate phenomenon was “supersizing before our...
summary.zh: 独家报道：安吉拉·伊格尔敦促人们‘更有韧性’，并告知英国公民为国家紧急情况做计划。英国民众被敦促储备足够几天的食物和水，以应对断电或断水的情况，因为联合国表示，厄尔尼诺气候现象‘在我们眼前变得越来越大’，加剧了全球范围内的极端天气事件。预报员称，他们正准备迎接千年以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，可能给世界部分地区带来野火和洪水...

body.en: Exclusive: Angela Eagle urges people to be ‘a bit more resilient’ as she tells UK citizens to plan for national emergencies British people have been urged to have enough food and water on hand to survive a few days without power or water, as the UN said the El Niño climate phenomenon was “supersizing before our eyes”, exacerbating extreme weather events worldwide. Forecasters say they are braced for the biggest El Niño in 1,000 years, bringing wildfires and floods to parts of the world, and the threat of a wet, stormy winter for the UK. As the British government plans a campaign urging citizens to prepare for national emergencies, Angela Eagle told the Guardian the likelihood of a wild winter showed the importance of having supplies at home. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：安吉拉·伊格尔敦促人们“更有韧性”，她告诉英国公民为国家紧急情况做好计划。联合国表示，厄尔尼诺气候现象“在我们眼前变得非常严重”，加剧了全球范围内的极端天气事件，英国人民被敦促手头有足够的食物和水，以便在没有电力或水的情况下生存几天。预报员表示，他们正在为1000年来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做好准备，这会给世界部分地区带来野火和洪水，并给英国带来潮湿、暴风雨冬天的威胁。英国政府计划开展一场运动，敦促公民为国家紧急情况做好准备，安吉拉·伊格尔告诉《卫报》，严冬的可能性表明了国内储备物资的重要性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As forecasters warn of the most powerful El Niño in a millennium, bringing potential floods and wildfires, a UK minister is urging citizens to prepare for emergencies. This call for resilience in the face of environmental upheaval reminds us that Yahweh is our ultimate refuge and strength in times of trouble. Even as we take practical steps to prepare, we...
reflection.zh: 随着预报员警告千年以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象可能带来洪水和野火，一位英国部长敦促市民为紧急情况做准备。这种在环境剧变面前呼吁韧性的做法，提醒我们雅伟是我们动荡时期最终的避难所和力量。即使我们采取实际措施进行准备，我们也可以在知道上帝是我们生命风暴中永恒的庇护所时找到平安。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Key tree species boost Amazon forest restoration, new study shows
title.zh: 关键树种助力亚马逊雨林恢复，新研究表明

summary.en: A new study in the Brazilian Amazon highlights the critical role of a few hyperdominant tree species in restoring biodiversity and carbon stocks in deforested areas, suggesting these species are key to preventing a 'quiet collapse' of regenerating forests.
summary.zh: 一项在巴西亚马逊地区进行的新研究强调，少数占主导地位的树种在恢复森林砍伐地区的生物多样性和碳储量方面起着至关重要的作用，这表明这些物种是防止再生森林“悄然崩溃”的关键。

body.en: A few tree species are key to restoring biodiversity and carbon storage in deforested areas of the Brazilian Amazon, suggests an article published in June in Global Change Biology. Researchers examined 102 plots under natural regeneration in four municipalities in Pará state — Bragantina, Marabá, Paragominas and Santarém — and concluded that a range of 15 to 25 species accounted for nearly half of the trees present and half of the plots’ carbon stocks. ​Among these species are the embaúba (Cecropia palmata), the tatapiririca (Tapirira guianensis), the ingá-vermelho (Inga alba), and the araticum-bravo (Annona exsucca). ​This relatively short list of hyperdominant species could “guide assisted restoration and enrichment strategies” in the Amazon, the researchers said, and help Brazil meet the goal of restoring 12 million hectares (30 million acres) of forests by 2030, an area roughly the size of North Korea. ​“These areas are already restoring [ecological] services and biodiversity,” Fernando Elias, a researcher in Pará’s Emílio Goeldi Museum and the coordinator of the study, told Mongabay. “That is why it is so important to understand how these forests behave.” According to Elias, the Brazilian Amazon has more than 140,000 square kilometers (around 57,000 square miles) of regrowing forests in areas previously deforested, known as secondary forests. In many cases, these lands have been abandoned after being used for cattle ranching. ​Most of it has the potential to recover naturally, without the need to plant a single seed. Close monitoring, however, is necessary to control fires, cattle ranching and land…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 六月发表在《全球变化生物学》杂志上的一篇文章指出，一些树种对于恢复巴西亚马逊森林砍伐地区的生物多样性和碳储存至关重要。研究人员检查了帕拉州四个城市（布拉干蒂纳、马拉巴、帕拉戈米纳斯和圣塔伦）的 102 个自然更新地块，得出的结论是，15 至 25 个物种占现有树木的近一半和地块碳储量的一半。这些物种包括 embaúba (Cecropia palmata)、tatapiirica (Tapirira guianensis)、ingá-vermelho (Inga alba) 和 araticum-bravo (Annona exsucca)。研究人员表示，这个相对较短的超级优势物种清单可以“指导亚马逊地区的辅助恢复和富集策略”，并帮助巴西实现到 2030 年恢复 1200 万公顷（3000 万英亩）森林的目标，该面积大约相当于朝鲜的面积。 â�<“这些地区已经在恢复[生态]服务和生物多样性，”帕拉州埃米利奥戈尔迪博物馆的研究员兼该研究的协调员费尔南多·埃利亚斯告诉Mongabay。 “这就是为什么了解这些森林的行为如此重要。”据埃利亚斯介绍，巴西亚马逊地区在之前被砍伐的地区有超过 140,000 平方公里（约 57,000 平方英里）的再生森林，称为次生林。在许多情况下，这些土地在用于养牛后就被废弃了。​其中大部分都有可能自然恢复，无需种植一粒种子。然而，密切监控对于控制火灾、养牛场和土地是必要的……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: Scientists have identified a handful of tree species essential for the Amazon's recovery, offering hope for restoring these vital ecosystems. This echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that He had made and declared it 'very good.' The intricate web of life, from the smallest seed to the grandest tree, reflects a divine artistry that calls for...
reflection.zh: 科学家们已经确定了对亚马逊恢复至关重要的少数几种树木，这为恢复这些重要的生态系统带来了希望。这与创世记中雅伟审视他一切所造之物并宣告“甚好”的记载相呼应。生命错综复杂的网络，从最小的种子到最宏伟的树木，都反映了神圣的艺术，呼唤我们谨慎地管理。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Cherokee youth win legal rights for waterway in first all-female U.S. effort
title.zh: 切罗基女孩在全女性美国首次努力中赢得水道的法律权利

summary.en: Young Cherokee women successfully advocated for the legal rights of a waterway, bringing water from its headwaters in traditional pottery into the council chambers. Their effort, supported by a large crowd, resulted in a unanimous tribal council resolution on January 8, 2026, in North Carolina.
summary.zh: 年轻的切罗基女性成功争取到一条水道的法律权利，她们将传统陶罐中收集的水源从源头带入议事厅。她们的努力得到了众多支持者的声援，并于2026年1月8日在北卡罗来纳州获得了部落委员会的一致通过。

body.en: Before the proceedings began, the young women carried Longperson into the room with them, water gathered from the mountain headwaters and held in traditional pottery. The chamber filled beyond capacity, supporters spilling into the lobby. When the vote came, the council passed the resolution unanimously. The crowd and the council rose in standing ovation. On Jan. 8, 2026, the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians (EBCI) Tribal Council convened in Cherokee, in what is today the U.S. state of North Carolina, to consider a resolution brought forward by the NAIWA Daughters, the youth arm of the North American Indian Women’s Association, made up of a group of Indigenous girls between the ages of 10 and 17. The resolution recognizes the inherent legal rights of the Longperson, or Ganvhidv Asgaya, the interconnected waterway system whose headwaters rise in the Great Smoky Mountains and travel more than 1,270 kilometers (790 miles), branching through multiple states before its “feet,” as the Cherokee describe it, reach the Gulf of Mexico. To the Tribe, Longperson (formerly Long Man) is a living entity of great cultural and spiritual significance. Zailiana Blythe, from NAIWA Daughters, speaks to the Council at the podium. Image from EBCI Tribal Council live-stream recording. “The room was heavy with the presence of Ancestors and community alike,” said Jasmine Smith, NAIWA Daughters chair and co-founder, describing the moment in a keynote speech at the Bioneers Conference in Berkeley, California. She delivered her speech wearing the moccasins of her Ancestor Ruth Littlejohn. “That day crystallized…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在诉讼开始前，年轻妇女们将朗曼带到了房间，水从山源收集并装在传统的陶器中。会议厅挤满了人，支持者涌入大厅。表决时，理事会一致通过了该决议。人群和议会起立鼓掌。 2026 年 1 月 8 日，切罗基印第安人东部部落 (EBCI) 部落理事会在切罗基（今天的美国北卡罗来纳州）召开会议，审议由北美印第安妇女协会的青年组织 NAIWA 女儿提出的一项决议，该组织由一群 10 至 17 岁的土著女孩组成。该决议承认长人的固有合法权利，或Ganvhidv Asgaya 是一个相互连接的水道系统，其源头发源于大烟山，行程超过 1,270 公里（790 英里），分支穿过多个州，然后用切罗基人的话说，到达墨西哥湾。对于部落来说，龙人（以前的龙人）是一个具有重大文化和精神意义的生物体。来自 NAIWA Daughters 的 Zailiana Blythe 在讲台上向理事会发表讲话。图片来自 EBCI 部落理事会直播录制。 “房间里挤满了祖先和社区的人，”NAIWA Daughters 主席兼联合创始人 Jasmine Smith 在加州伯克利举行的 Bioneers 会议上发表主题演讲时描述了这一时刻。她穿着她祖先露丝·利特尔约翰 (Ruth Littlejohn) 的鹿皮鞋发表演讲。 “那一天具体化了……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: These young women, carrying water from the headwaters, embodied a deep connection to their ancestral lands and the natural world. Their successful advocacy for the waterway demonstrates the power of a clear voice speaking for the voiceless, reminding us that even the most vulnerable parts of creation deserve our defense and care. Their victory is a...
reflection.zh: 这些年轻女性带着源头的水，体现了她们与祖传土地和自然世界的深厚联系。她们为水道成功进行的倡导，展示了清晰的声音为无声者发声的力量，提醒我们，即使是造物中最脆弱的部分也值得我们去捍卫和关爱。她们的胜利证明了植根于传统和对遗产的热爱的、持续而忠实的行动的力量。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Hundreds gather to urge Scottish government to pause datacentre boom
title.zh: 数百人聚集敦促苏格兰政府暂停数据中心热潮

summary.en: Opposition is mounting as at least 20 datacentre projects are proposed in Scotland, including one in Fife that is being billed as the second largest in the world. Hundreds gathered in Edinburgh to call for an immediate moratorium on this expansion.
summary.zh: 苏格兰至少有20个数据中心项目被提议，其中包括一个号称是世界第二大的项目，反对声音日益高涨。数百人聚集在爱丁堡，呼吁立即暂停这一扩张。

body.en: Opposition mounts as at least 20 projects proposed, including one in Fife billed as second largest in world Kat Jones may be the closest thing Scotland has to Erin Brockovich in 2026. Standing in the shadow of Arthur’s Seat outside Holyrood, the 52-year-old is revving up the crowd of protesters around her. “Who is here from Lammermuir? Ayrshire? What about Aberdeen?” she calls to the crowd. On Thursday, hundreds travelled to Edinburgh to call for an immediate moratorium on Scotland’s datacentre boom, which includes one project in Auchtertool, Fife, that has been billed as the second largest in the world. Continue reading...
body.zh: 至少有 20 个拟议项目遭到反对，其中包括号称世界第二大的法夫郡的一个项目。凯特·琼斯 (Kat Jones) 可能是 2026 年苏格兰最接近艾琳·布罗科维奇 (Erin Brockovich) 的项目。这位 52 岁的女士站在荷里路德外亚瑟王宝座的阴影下，让周围的抗议者兴奋不已。 “谁来自拉默缪尔？艾尔郡？阿伯丁呢？”她向人群喊道。周四，数百人前往爱丁堡，呼吁立即暂停苏格兰数据中心的繁荣，其中包括位于法夫郡奥赫特图尔​​的一个项目，该项目被誉为世界第二大数据中心。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for a pause on Scotland's datacentre boom, led by activists like Kat Jones, echoes the ancient cry for justice and righteousness. When systems prioritize rapid growth over ecological or community well-being, the prophetic voice calls for a halt, demanding that justice roll down like waters. May this moment of protest lead to a more balanced and...
reflection.zh: 由卡特·琼斯等活动家领导的呼吁暂停苏格兰数据中心热潮的行动，呼应了古老的对公义和正直的呼求。当系统优先考虑快速增长而非生态或社区福祉时，先知的呼声要求停止，并要求公义如水滚滚。”愿这一抗议时刻能带来一个更平衡、更可持续的方法。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: A ‘lost’ Philippine pigeon reappears after 20 years — but its forest is disappearing
title.zh: “失踪”的菲律宾鸽子在 20 年后重新出现——但它的森林正在消失

summary.en: A camera trap on the Philippine island of Mindoro has photographed one of the country’s rarest birds, confirming that the critically endangered Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon still survives in the wild. Captured in August in the Puerto Galera rainforest, the image is the first confirmed photograph of the species...
summary.zh: 菲律宾民都洛岛的一台相机陷阱拍摄到了该国最稀有的鸟类之一，证实了濒危的民都洛血胸鸽仍然野外生存。根据非营利组织菲律宾保护创新中心（CCIPH）的说法，这张于 8 月在波多黎各加莱拉雨林拍摄到的照片是二十年来首次确认拍摄到该物种 Gallicolumba platenae。

body.en: A camera trap on the Philippine island of Mindoro has photographed one of the country’s rarest birds, confirming that the critically endangered Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon still survives in the wild. Captured in August in the Puerto Galera rainforest, the image is the first confirmed photograph of the species Gallicolumba platenae in two decades, according to the nonprofit organization Center for Conservation Innovation Ph Inc. (CCIPH). “For an extremely rare and secretive species, a single image can carry enormous weight,” CCIPH researchers wrote in a Sept. 3 announcement. “It confirms that the bird continues to survive within the landscape.” Juan Carlos Gonzalez, an ornithologist and director of the Museum of Natural History at the University of the Philippines Los Baños, independently confirmed that the image shows a Mindoro bleeding-heart. “This record not only proves that this very rare species continues to persist in these steep rainforests, but solidifies the importance of Puerto Galera as a UNESCO biosphere reserve and an important sanctuary for this critically endangered species,” Gonzalez told Mongabay by email. Mindoro Bleeding-heart captured via camera trap. Image courtesy of CCIPH. Alex Berryman, who oversees species conservation assessments for Asia at the NGO BirdLife International, also separately confirmed the identification. “There is no doubt that this refers to a Mindoro bleeding-heart,” Berryman told Mongabay by email. Berryman said the orange-red spot on the bird’s otherwise white chest, together with the iridescent green plumage on its head and neck, make it readily identifiable. Gonzalez also pointed to its blue-green and brown…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 菲律宾民都洛岛上的一个相机陷阱拍摄到了该国最稀有的鸟类之一，证实极度濒危的民都洛血心鸽仍然在野外生存。据非营利组织保护创新中心 (CCIPH) 称，这张照片于 8 月在加莱拉港热带雨林拍摄，是二十年来第一张经证实的 Gallicolumba Platenae 物种照片。 CCIPH 研究人员在 9 月 3 日的一份公告中写道：“对于一种极其稀有且神秘的物种，一张图像可以承载巨大的重量。” “这证实了这只鸟继续在这片土地上生存。”鸟类学家、菲律宾洛斯巴尼奥斯大学自然历史博物馆馆长胡安·卡洛斯·冈萨雷斯独立证实，该图像显示了民都洛岛流血的心脏。 “这一记录不仅证明了这种非常稀有的物种继续存在于这些陡峭的雨林中，而且巩固了加莱拉港作为联合国教科文组织生物圈保护区和这种极度濒危物种的重要保护区的重要性，”冈萨雷斯通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。通过相机陷阱捕捉到的民都洛岛流血心脏。图片由 CCIPH 提供。非政府组织国际鸟盟负责亚洲物种保护评估的亚历克斯·贝里曼（Alex Berryman）也单独证实了这一身份。 “毫无疑问，这指的是民都洛人的心在流血，”贝里曼通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。贝里曼说，这只鸟白色​​胸部上的橙红色斑点，加上头部和颈部的虹彩绿色羽毛，使其很容易辨认。冈萨雷斯还指出了它的蓝绿色和棕色……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The reappearance of the Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon after two decades is a moment of profound wonder, reminding us of the intricate beauty Yahweh has woven into creation. Even as its forest habitat faces threats, this rediscovery offers a glimmer of hope and underscores the deep wisdom inherent in the natural world.
reflection.zh: 民都洛血胸鸽在二十年后重新出现，这是一个充满惊奇的时刻，提醒我们雅伟已将精妙之美编织进祂的创造之中。即使它的森林栖息地面临威胁，这次的重新发现也带来了一线希望，并强调了自然界固有的深邃智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Grinding up fish to feed to fish is ‘absurd’: fears over UN aquaculture plan
title.zh: 联合国水产养殖计划引发担忧：将鱼磨碎喂养养殖鱼类是“荒谬的”

summary.en: Experts warn that a massive expansion of fish farms, as proposed by the UN's Food and Agriculture Organization, could damage ecosystems and jeopardize the food security of vulnerable communities. The plan aims to increase aquaculture production by 75% by 2040, which could result in nearly half of the world's wild fish...
summary.zh: 专家警告称，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）提出的水产养殖大规模扩张计划可能会破坏生态系统并危及弱势社区的粮食安全。该计划旨在到2040年将水产养殖产量提高75%，这可能导致全球近一半的野生鱼类捕捞量被用于喂养养殖鱼类。

body.en: Huge rollout of fish farms could harm ecosystems and threaten vulnerable communities’ food sources, say experts Nearly half of the world’s wild fish catch will be ground into animal feed for farmed fish if plans to expand aquaculture go ahead, a report has found. The UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) is aiming to increase aquaculture – where fish are farmed rather than caught in the wild – production by 75% by 2040. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，大规模的养鱼场可能会损害生态系统并威胁脆弱社区的食物来源。一份报告发现，如果扩大水产养殖的计划继续下去，世界上近一半的野生鱼类捕获量将被磨成养殖鱼类的动物饲料。联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 的目标是到 2040 年将水产养殖（鱼类是养殖而非野生捕获）产量提高 75%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The UN's ambitious plan to expand aquaculture, grinding wild fish to feed farmed ones, raises concerns about ecological balance and human sustenance. It prompts reflection on the intricate web of life Yahweh has created, as Psalm 104:24 reminds us, "How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures."
reflection.zh: 联合国为扩大水产养殖业而将野生鱼类磨碎喂养养殖鱼类的宏伟计划，引发了对生态平衡和人类生计的担忧。这促使我们反思雅伟所创造的生命错综复杂的网络，正如诗篇104:24所提醒我们的：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造的；全地充满了你的造物。”

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Judge rules 2,000 Catalina Island deer can be killed to save native plant species
title.zh: 法官裁定可杀死 2,000 只圣卡塔利娜岛鹿以拯救本地植物物种

summary.en: A judge has allowed the island's conservancy to proceed with killing nearly all of Catalina Island's 2,000 mule deer. These deer consume native shrubs, which in turn allows fast-igniting grasses to spread. The decision comes despite significant opposition from locals and tourists who have long cherished the deer...
summary.zh: 一名法官已允许该岛保护协会继续杀死圣卡塔利娜岛上近 2,000 只骡鹿。这些鹿以本地灌木为食，导致易燃的草类得以蔓延。尽管当地居民和游客长期以来一直珍视这些近一个世纪以来一直是岛上熟悉景色的鹿群，并对此表示强烈反对，但该裁决仍得以通过。

body.en: Cull of animals that eat native shrubs, causing spread of fast-igniting grasses, to go ahead despite fierce opposition Locals and tourists have long fawned over Catalina Island’s mule deer population. For nearly a century, the ungulates have roamed the land’s waterfronts and woodlands, so comfortable around humans that it is not uncommon to spot deer roaming downtown Avalon. But that sight will soon disappear, after a judge this week paved the way for the island’s conservancy to kill nearly all the island’s 2,000 deer. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，但仍继续扑杀以本地灌木为食的动物，导致快速燃烧的草类蔓延。当地人和游客长期以来一直对卡塔利娜岛的黑尾鹿种群表示欢迎。近一个世纪以来，有蹄类动物一直在这片土地的海滨和林地中漫步，它们在人类周围非常舒适，因此在阿瓦隆市中心漫步的鹿并不罕见。但这种景象很快就会消失，因为本周一名法官为该岛的保护机构杀死了岛上几乎所有的 2000 只鹿铺平了道路。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The delicate balance of ecosystems, like the one on Catalina Island, reveals the profound wisdom woven into Yahweh's creation. When human intervention becomes necessary to restore that balance, as with the deer cull, it underscores the intricate interconnectedness of life and our responsibility to steward it.
reflection.zh: 圣卡塔利娜岛上生态系统的微妙平衡，彰显了雅伟创造中蕴含的深邃智慧。当人类干预成为恢复这种平衡的必要手段时，例如这次的鹿群扑杀，就凸显了生命之间错综复杂的相互联系，以及我们管理它的责任。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A Surge of Marine Heat Waves Threatens to Scramble Ocean Life
title.zh: 海洋热浪激增，威胁要扰乱海洋生物

summary.en: Record-breaking marine heat waves, driven by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, are affecting oceans globally and severely disrupting marine life. Evidence suggests these events could cause long-lasting damage both on land and at sea. For example, an unusually large bloom of common octopuses has appeared off...
summary.zh: 受气候变化和不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，创纪录的海浪热浪正在席卷全球海洋，并对海洋生物造成严重破坏。越来越多的证据表明，这些事件可能对陆地和海洋都造成严重且持久的损害。例如，英国海岸出现了有史以来规模最大的普通章鱼幼体聚集现象，这与异常温暖的海水有关。

body.en:
Fueled by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, record-setting marine heat waves are gripping oceans worldwide and playing havoc with sea life. Mounting evidence from recent events suggests the damage could be severe and long-lasting, both onshore and off.

The common octopus is a warm water species that usually lives in the temperate waters of the Mediterranean. But last year, octopus larvae hitchhiked across the English Channel attached to plankton, resulting in an octopus bloom off England’s coast. This year, the bloom is the largest it’s been in 75 years.

Normally, octopus larvae that drift into cold waters die. But this year’s bloom, experts say, is the result of an unusually intense marine heat wave off of Devon and Cornwall, which raised water temperatures up to 9 degrees F above normal.

The change in species has been a boon for local fishers selling octopus into the lucrative European export market. (Octopus landings along the U.K.’s southwest coast were roughly 7,700 percent higher than usual in 2025.) And while the invasion has slashed the catch of scallops, lobster, and crab, it has boosted numbers of seals, conger eels, and dolphins, which eat octopus. The warming, in combination with abundant prey, has also drawn bluefin tuna and sharks to British waters for the first time in decades.

“It has completely shaken up the food chain,” said Bryce Stewart, a senior research fellow at the UK’s Marine Biological Association, which has been studying the phenomenon. While this kind of bloom has happened here before, he said, this one is different. During past surges, the return of cold water killed off the octopuses. This time, the octopuses aren’t dying. They’re reproducing.

Globally, marine heat waves — prolonged periods of unusually warm water — are becoming more common, more intense, longer lasting, and more widespread, experts say . This year, ocean heat is unusually severe, setting new temperature records . According to Global Climate Risks, a nonprofit created by scientists to publicize the effects of climate change, an estimated 82 percent of the world’s oceans are currently experiencing marine heat waves. Evidence from recent hot spells suggests the impacts on sea life could be profound and long-lasting.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

Ocean fevers can rearrange marine ecosystems, drive fish to move into deeper, colder layers of the sea, trigger coral bleaching, and cause widespread marine die-offs. They can increase the severity and number of algal blooms, which harm fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and birds. And they can cause extreme weather events, like tropical storms and hurricanes, and upend fishing and tourism.

To officially be called a heat wave, temperatures...
body.zh: 在气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧的推动下，创纪录的海洋热浪正在席卷全球海洋，对海洋生物造成严重破坏。最近发生的事件中越来越多的证据表明，无论是陆上还是海上，损害都可能是严重且持久的。 普通章鱼是温水物种，通常生活在地中海温带水域。但去年，章鱼幼虫附着在浮游生物上，搭便车穿越英吉利海峡，导致英格兰海岸出现章鱼大量繁​​殖。今年的花期是 75 年来规模最大的一次。 通常情况下，章鱼幼虫漂入冷水后就会死亡。但专家表示，今年的水华是德文郡和康沃尔郡异常强烈的海洋热浪造成的，导致水温比正常水平高出 9 华氏度。 物种的变化对于将章鱼销往利润丰厚的欧洲出口市场的当地渔民来说是一个福音。 （2025 年，英国西南海岸的章鱼登陆量比平时增加了大约 7,700%。）虽然入侵减少了扇贝、龙虾和螃蟹的捕获量，但以章鱼为食的海豹、海鳗和海豚的数量却增加了。气候变暖加上丰富的猎物，几十年来首次将蓝鳍金枪鱼和鲨鱼吸引到英国水域。 “它彻底撼动了食物链，”一直在研究这一现象的英国海洋生物协会高级研究员布莱斯·斯图尔特说。他说，虽然以前这里也发生过这种花，但这次不同。在过去的海潮中，冷水的回归导致章鱼死亡。这一次，章鱼没有死。他们正在繁殖。 专家表示，在全球范围内，海洋热浪（长时间异常温暖的海水）正变得更加常见、更加强烈、持续时间更长、范围更广。今年，海洋高温异常严重，创下了新的气温记录。据科学家创建、旨在宣传气候变化影响的非营利组织“全球气候风险”估计，目前世界上 82% 的海洋正在经历海洋热浪。最近的高温天气的证据表明，这对海洋生物的影响可能是深远而持久的。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 海洋热可以重新安排海洋生态系统，促使鱼类进入更深、更冷的海层，引发珊瑚白化，并导致广泛的海洋死亡。它们会增加藻华的严重程度和数量，从而危害鱼类、贝类、海洋哺乳动物和鸟类。它们还可能引发热带风暴和飓风等极端天气事件，并颠覆渔业和旅游业。 正式称为热浪，温度...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep sigh, and Romans 8 echoes this, describing all of creation groaning as in labor pains. We see this groaning in the oceans, where rising temperatures disrupt ancient ecosystems and lead to unexpected blooms, like the octopus surge off England's coast. It is a reminder that the natural world, in its current state,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾提到受造界的深沉叹息，罗马书第八章也呼应了这一点，将万物描述为一同叹息，如同经历生产之苦。我们在海洋中看到了这种叹息，不断升高的温度扰乱了古老的生态系统，并导致了意想不到的生物爆发，例如英国海岸的章鱼激增。这提醒我们，自然界在其现状下，也承载着影响所有生命的堕落的痕迹。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: I camped in one of Britain’s last remaining rainforests
title.zh: 我在英国最后一片雨林之一露营

summary.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest on the edge of Dartmoor, the subject of years of conservation efforts, has now opened to the public with a sustainable campsite. The author describes their experience camping near this delicate ecosystem, known as Atlantic woodland.
summary.zh: 位于德文郡达特穆尔边缘的一小片温带雨林，经过多年的保育工作，现已开放并设有一个可持续露营地。作者描述了在这一脆弱生态系统——被称为大西洋林地——附近露营的经历。

body.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest lies on the edge of Dartmoor, and following years of conservation work, its owners have now opened up a sustainable campsite next to this fragile ecosystem Mist blankets the valley as I wheel my camping gear down the small hill towards a clearing ringed by trees and shrubs. A picnic bench sits at its edge, angled towards the reason why I’m here: one of the last remaining fragments of temperate rainforest in Britain. I’m pitching my tent at Wray Valley Camping, a low-impact site on Dartmoor’s eastern edge between Lustleigh and Moretonhampstead, where I’ll spend five days on one of the site’s “nearly wild” pitches. Also known as Atlantic woodland, temperate rainforests depend on a rare combination of high humidity, rainfall and consistently mild coastal temperatures where the sea moderates the climate. They once stretched from the western Highlands of Scotland down to Cornwall, covering 20% of the UK , and sheltering rare and delicate lichens and plants. Today more than 95% of our temperate rainforest cover is gone, but Devon’s near-constant dampness and its exposure to the Atlantic make it one of the last strongholds for this rare habitat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 达特穆尔边缘有一片温带雨林，经过多年的保护工作，它的主人现在在这个脆弱的生态系统旁边开辟了一个可持续的露营地。当我推着露营装备沿着小山坡走向一片树木和灌木环绕的空地时，薄雾笼罩着整个山谷。一条野餐长凳坐落在它的边缘，与我来这里的原因成一定角度：英国仅存的温带雨林碎片之一。我正在雷谷露营地搭帐篷，这是达特穆尔东部边缘勒斯特利和莫顿汉普斯特德之间一个影响较小的营地，我将在该营地“近乎荒野”的营地之一待上五天。温带雨林也被称为大西洋林地，依赖于高湿度、降雨量和持续温和的沿海温度（海洋调节气候）的罕见组合。它们曾经从苏格兰西部高地一直延伸到康沃尔郡，覆盖了英国20%的面积，并庇护着稀有而娇嫩的地衣和植物。如今，超过 95% 的温带雨林覆盖面已经消失，但德文郡几乎持续潮湿且暴露在大西洋中，使其成为这一稀有栖息地的最后据点之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author's experience in Britain's dwindling temperate rainforest highlights the preciousness of creation. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning, awaiting its redemption (Romans 8:22). This fragile ecosystem, carefully tended, offers a glimpse of what Yahweh intends for all of nature.
reflection.zh: 作者在英国日益稀少的温带雨林中的经历，凸显了受造界的宝贵。使徒保罗提到，万物都在一同叹息，等候得赎（罗马书 8:22）。这片精心呵护的脆弱生态系统，让我们得以一窥雅伟对万物的心意。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Australia’s new environmental protection agency approves coal project, angering climate groups
title.zh: 澳大利亚新环保机构批准煤炭项目，激怒气候团体

summary.en: Australia's new national environmental protection agency has approved its first coal project, allowing the Saraji mine in Queensland to continue operations until 2055, despite clearing threatened woodland and koala habitat. This approval comes as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese denies tensions with Pacific leaders...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚新成立的国家环境保护机构已批准其首个煤炭项目，允许昆士兰州的 Saraji 矿继续运营至 2055 年，尽管该项目会清除受威胁的林地和考拉栖息地。此批准是在总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯否认与太平洋国家在澳大利亚化石燃料出口问题上存在紧张关系之际做出的。

body.en: Queensland open-cut Saraji mine will be able to keep digging until 2055 as Anthony Albanese denies tensions with Pacific leaders over fossil fuels Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s new national agency for environmental protection has approved its first coal project, allowing a Queensland open-cut mine to keep digging until 2055 while clearing threatened woodland and koala habitat. The confirmation of the extension of the Saraji mine, which digs and exports coal for steel making, comes after the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, denied this week there was tension over Australia’s fossil fuel exports during talks with Pacific leaders.
